products.title: Armaf Club De Nuit Intense Man Pure Parfum
products.body_html:
Armaf Club De Nuit Intense Man Pure Parfum is a bold and powerful fragrance for men, launched in 2021. It has become one of the most talked-about scents in the men’s fragrance world for its rich, smoky, and masculine aroma. Inspired by the luxury scent of Creed Aventus, this perfume opens with a sharp, citrusy blast and slowly transforms into a deep, woody experience. It’s perfect for men who prefer their perfume to be strong, long-lasting, and full of personality.


This version of the Pure Parfum is the most refined and intense in the Club De Nuit Intense range, offering a smooth yet powerful aroma that’s perfect for both daily use and special occasions.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Ice Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Ice Eau De Parfum is a fresh and aromatic perfume for men. Launched in 2023, it opens with a burst of fruity and citrus notes of apple, Italian lemon, Sicilian bergamot and star anise. The middle contains majesty plum, orange blossom and cardamom, giving a sweet and spicy impression, while the base leaves a warm musk, amber, driftwood and moss trail that is long lasting.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Eau De Parfum For Men
products.body_html: Hawas for Him by Rasasi is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for men. Hawas for Him was launched in 2015. Top notes are Apple, Bergamot, Lemon and Cinnamon; middle notes are Watery Notes, Plum, Cardamom and Orange Blossom; base notes are Ambergris, Musk, Patchouli and Driftwood.

products.title: Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa Eau de Parfum is a sweet, spicy and creamy scent made for both men and women. This perfume brings together the cozy warmth of cinnamon and cardamom with the smooth sweetness of praline and vanilla. The mix of coffee and tonka bean gives it a deep, rich aroma that feels comforting yet classy. It’s a perfect scent for people who love strong, dessert like perfumes with a warm base that stays beautifully on the skin.

products.title: Afnan 9pm Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9pm Eau de Parfum is one of the most admired amber vanilla fragrances for men, launched in 2020. The scent is a popular choice amongst fragrance enthusiasts, one sharing similarity with Jean Paul Gaultier’s Ultra Male. The perfume’s bold and seductive composition featuring a rich blend of sweet, spicy and warm notes makes it ideal for evening wear, romantic date nights and cooler seasons of the year.

products.title: French Avenue Liquid Brun Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Liquid Brun Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and woody men’s perfume for those who enjoy creamy, cozy scents. Launched in 2024, this perfume opens with spicy, fresh notes of cinnamon, cardamom, bergamot and soft orange blossom. The middle is smooth, creamy, and tastes of bourbon, vanilla, elemi and has a soothing impression. It has a deep and addictive base with praline, ambroxan, guaiac wood and musk that leave a sweet woody scent that is modern and bold, yet most of all wearable.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Collectors Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum is a modern, fresh, and classy men’s fragrance that brings confidence with every spray. Inspired by timeless elegance, this scent mixes fruity freshness with warm woody notes, making it perfect for the man who wants to stand out.

The first spray greets you with a burst of juicy pineapple, crisp apple, and fresh bergamot balanced with delicate white flowers. As it settles, you’ll notice the heart of orange blossom, smooth birch, and warm amber adding depth and richness. The dry-down is where Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum shines earthy oak moss, clean musk, and unique ambergris, leaving a long-lasting, masculine trail that people won’t forget.

Whether you’re dressing up for a special event or adding a touch of class to your daily look, Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum is your perfect companion.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Blue Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Turathi Blue is a crisp, fresh, and uplifting scent crafted for the modern man. It starts with a burst of zesty bergamot and mandarin, creating an energizing first impression. The scent then drifts into warm amber, entwined with woody nuances, before finally resting on a base of smooth musk and patchouli with a touch of spice. Ideal for everyday wear, it is both refined and approachable with a touch of Middle Eastern richness.

products.title: Lattafa Angham Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Angham Eau de Parfum is a women's and men's Oriental Vanilla perfume. This is a new fragrance. Angham was launched in 2024. Ginger, Mandarin and Pink Pepper, Lavender, Praline, Cacao, Jasmine, Vanilla, Amber and Musk are the top, middle, and base notes, respectively. It is a pleasant, warm and a little spicy aroma which is gentle, creamy and prolonged to the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Nebras Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Nebras Eau de Parfum is a sweet, warm and cozy unisex scent that feels like a creamy vanilla dessert with a soft fruity touch on top. It opens with juicy red berries and a fresh mandarin orange. In the middle the main characters are smooth vanilla, cacao with a trace of soft rose. With the last notes of sugar, tonka bean amber, and clean musk make the base turn warm and welcoming.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Not Only Intense Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Supremacy Not Only Intense EDP Spray is a rich and masculine fragrance with a deep, contemporary and smoky character balanced by fruity freshness. The perfume creates a unique scent that lasts all day, smoothly blending crisp apple and bergamot with warm saffron notes and dark musky undertones.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kaaf Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Kaaf Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2022 by the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house as a fresh aquatic fragrance with a floral and fruity composition and a musky drydown. It has the top notes of red fruits, watermelon, lavender and Sicilian orange; a heart of sweet floral bouquet of lotus, jasmine, and lily of the valley; and a musky base with warm sandalwood and Ambroxan

products.title: Afnan 9PM Rebel Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9PM Rebel Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume launched in 2024 by Afnan Perfumes. It was created by perfumer Gaël Montero it is a fruity-aromatic scent with a playful yet classy touch. The perfume opens with juicy pineapple, fresh green apple and sweet mandarin (top notes). The middle notes combine creamy vanilla, oakmoss and cedarwood for a smooth balance. Finally, the base leaves a warm trail of ambergris, dry woods, caramel and musk that lingers beautifully.

products.title: Al Wataniah Kayaan Classic Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Wataniah Kayaan Classic Eau de Parfum is a smooth, warm and classy unisex perfume from Al Wataniah. It opens with fresh citrus notes that feel clean and bright. Slowly, the scent turns soft, spicy and floral in the middle, giving it a rich and elegant feel. The base of the fragrance contains sweet and creamy woody elements, which produce a comforting scent that lasts for a long time. Al Wataniah Kayaan Classic Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who enjoy oriental vanilla fragrances with a modern touch.

products.title: Lattafa Yara Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Yara Eau De Parfum is a soft, sweet and creamy perfume for women who enjoy warm vanilla scents with a tropical twist. The top notes are the gentle combination of orchid, heliotrope and a bit of fresh tangerine. The middle notes deliver the sweetness of the gourmand and the juiciness of the tropical fruits mixed. Finally, the fragrance dries down to a warm and comforting base of vanilla, soft musk and sandalwood that keeps the smoothness on the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Eclaire Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Eclaire Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy and comforting perfume that wraps you in a soft, cozy scent. Perfume for women, this scent feels like a warm dessert in a bottle. The aroma starts with the notes of caramel, milk and sugar, which create a smooth and creamy first impression. Then it changes to a floral and golden scent with honey and white flowers while the base floats away into vanilla, praline and musk.

products.title: Afnan  Modest Une Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Modest Une Eau de Parfum is a modern men’s fragrance that was launched in 2019. It is an aromatic spicy combination made for men who like fresh, bold and long-lasting perfumes. The opening comes with sharp pepper, soothing lavender, cool mint and spicy nutmeg. The middle notes bring citrus, warm amber and refreshing eucalyptus. The base is masculine with musk, vetiver and cedarwood giving it depth and strength that stays for hours.

products.title: Lattafa Najdia Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Najdia Eau De Parfum is a fresh and bright unisex scent that mixes citrus, light spices, soft woods and clean watery notes. It opens with a sharp hit of lemon, bergamot, cinnamon, apple and lemongrass that gives an instant fresh-spicy feeling. Then the heart brings refreshing watery notes, lavender, rosemary and cardamom that make the scent clean, cool and smooth. Finally, the base gets all warm and cozy with musk, amber, sandalwood, cedar and a slight touch of tobacco which adds a gentle depth to the perfume without making it too heavy.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Electric Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Turathi Electric Eau de Parfum is a fresh, bright and modern unisex perfume. Launched in 2025, this fragrance opens with juicy and citrusy notes that feel clean and energetic. As it settles, soft florals and fruity tones come out, making it smooth and pleasant. The warmth of musk, amber and vanilla in the base gives the perfume a balanced, easy everyday fragrance.

products.title: Riiffs Fleurie Violette Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Fleurie Violette Eau de Parfum is a soft, feminine scent for women who like gentle floral perfumes. It opens with fresh rose and white flowers mixed with a light woody touch of cashmere wood. After a few minutes, it turns creamy and sweet with vanilla bean and coconut notes that feel smooth and comforting. The dry down is warm and cozy, with tonka bean, amber and musk that stay on skin nicely and leave a soft, elegant trail.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Men Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Pour Homme Eau De Parfum is a fresh and clean fragrance for men. It makes one experience of a cool ocean breeze on a hot, sunny day. It was launched in 2017. The Eau De Parfum begins with a sweet burst of grapefruit scent along with mandarin orange. The heart tones are surrounded by the warm musk  and amberwood smell. The soft and confident smell makes you effortlessly attractive on any day.

products.title: Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum is a bright, fresh, and modern unisex fragrance that mixes juicy citrus with smooth woods and soft musk. Inspired by sunny days and easy elegance, this perfume opens with a splash of zesty Sicilian lemon, refreshing bergamot, and a hint of spicy black currant. As it settles, fruity notes blend with soft jasmine and earthy patchouli leaf, adding depth and charm. The dry-down is warm and creamy with cedar, leather, vanilla, and white musk that stay on your skin for hours.

Mancera Cedrat Boise is a perfect everyday fragrance for people who love fresh, energetic scents with a classy twist. It feels youthful yet sophisticated, making it a favourite for both men and women who want to smell fresh, clean, and stylish all day long.

products.title: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud Oud for Glory Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bade’e Al Oud Oud for Glory Eau De Parfum is a strong and deep Arabic perfume made for both men and women who love rich oud scents. It starts with spicy and warm notes of saffron, nutmeg, and lavender, which make the fragrance bold right from the beginning. The main part of the perfume features soft patchouli and burnt agarwood (oud) giving the scent a dark and classy character. At last, the base of agarwood, patchouli, and musk come together in a very organic way, leaving behind a warm and long-lasting scent trail.

products.title: Lattafa Yara Candy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Yara Candy Eau de Parfum is a sweet, fun and playful perfume made for women who love soft, fruity scents with a candy twist. The opening provides a delightful blend of black currant and green tangerine, which is a very juicy one. A pop of sweet strawberry fizz combined with a pale floral gardenia note resides in the heart. The final stage of the perfume is warm and creamy, with notes of vanilla, musk, amber, and sandalwood.

products.title: Diptyque Tam Dao Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Diptyque Tam Dao Eau De Parfum is a calm, woody, and comforting unisex fragrance that brings to mind the peaceful beauty of sandalwood forests. Inspired by the mountains of Tonkin in Vietnam, this perfume is a tribute to sacred woods and age-old traditions. Tam Dao is simple yet rich, perfect for those who love warm, woody, and smooth scents with a soft floral base. Tam Dao is ideal for people who prefer minimalism in scent – smooth, clean, and soothing.

products.title: Afnan Historic Sahara Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Historic Sahara Eau de Parfum is a warm and sweet unisex perfume from the house of Afnan. Launched in 2025, this scent feels rich, cozy and a little spicy. The opening is very fresh and spicy due to the presence of cardamom, cinnamon and bergamot. The middle is very comforting and sweet with vanilla, sugar and elemi. The base makes one feel deep and pleased with praline, almond, tonka, musk and ambroxan. It is a smooth oriental vanilla scent that feels modern but still has that desert warmth vibe.

products.title: Khadlaj Island Dreams Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Island Dreams Extrait de Parfum is a cool and warm oriental perfume that is aimed at both women and men. It begins with a spicy ginger touch combined with bright bergamot, which is a clean and slightly sharp beginning. The heart then soon introduces a juicy feel of grapefruit that adds freshness. Musk and ambroxan base enable it to be smooth, soft, and long-lasting on the skin. It is contemporary, elegant, and comfortable.

products.title: Nusuk Al Mukhtalif Signature Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Al Mukhtalif Signature Extrait de Parfum is a decadent and bold men’s fragrance from the house of Nusuk. Released in 2024, it brings a deep woody aromatic scent style with a strong Middle Eastern touch. The scent opens with a powerful mix of oud, sandalwood, rose, amber, bergamot, neroli and jasmine, which feels warm and slightly fresh at the same time. The middle blends agarwood, patchouli, cedar, lemon, rose and jasmine, giving it a woody floral depth. The base settles into smooth oud, musk and vanilla, leaving a soft, sweet, woody trail that feels classy and long lasting.

products.title: Riiffs Prive Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Prive Noir Eau de Parfum is a bold leather fragrance for men who like strong and classy scents. Launched in 2023, this perfume opens fresh and slightly spicy, then slowly turns warm, woody and deep. Riiffs Prive Noir Eau de Parfum has a creamy leather base that gives it a dark, powerful feel.

products.title: Nautica Voyage Man Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Nautica Voyage Eau De Toilette for men is a fresh, clean and easy-going fragrance from the house of Nautica. It is made for daily wear and feels light, cool and relaxing. The scent opens with crisp green leaves and juicy apple that feels very fresh on first spray. The heart of the fragrance introduces the very gentle floral notes of lotus and mimosa that provide a creamy and watery sensation. Finally, musk, cedar, oakmoss and amber round up the scent’s drying process, making it a very clean but to a great extent still gentle and pleasant woody base on the skin.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige La Di Da Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige La Di Da Homme Eau de Parfum is a fresh yet spicy men’s perfume made for everyday confidence. It opens with bright citrus notes that feel clean and energetic, then slowly moves into warm spicy tones. The dry down is soft, sweet and musky, which makes the scent feel smooth and easy to wear. Arabiyat Prestige La Di Da Homme Eau de Parfum feels fresh at first and later becomes warm and comforting on the skin.

products.title: Davidoff Cool Water Man Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Davidoff Cool Water Man Eau De Toilette is a classic men’s perfume known for its cool, fresh and confident vibe. Launched in 1988, it’s still a favorite for those who love clean and ocean-like scents. It starts with a mix of mint, green notes, lavender and rosemary, giving a crisp freshness, then brings soft hints of sandalwood, jasmine, and geranium. Finally, the base adds depth with musk, cedar, ambergris and tobacco, making it long lasting, masculine and refreshing all day.

products.title: Rasasi Daarej Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Daarej Eau De Parfum is a strong and sweet scent for men that gives a feeling of luxury and elegance. The spicy opening with cumin and cardamom is rich and a bit refreshing at the same time. Little by little, the gentle rose and powdery orris appear and smoothen out the fragrance. Finally, vanilla, amber, and woods create a soft and very persistent end. This perfume is strong, masculine, and an ideal choice for the self-assured man.

products.title: Lattafa Ramz Silver Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ramz Silver Eau De Parfum is a smooth and modern unisex scent that opens fresh and sweet at the same time. It starts with juicy pear, soft lavender, cool mint and bright bergamot. The heart brings warm cardamom and clean sage. The dry-down is rich and cosy with vanilla, amber, musk and patchouli.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Tropical Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Tropical Eau de Parfum is a fresh, tropical scent for men who like cool, green, slightly sweet perfumes. Launched in 2025, this scent opens with juicy coconut water, green fig leaf and spicy ginger, which gives it a lively start. The middle features creamy coconut, fresh fig and mint, making it feel breezy and clean. The base is soft and warm with sandalwood, tonka bean and musk, creating a smooth tropical trail that smells modern and relaxed at the same time.

products.title: Khadlaj Vanilla Dunes Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Island Vanilla Dunes Extrait de Parfum is a sweet, warm oriental vanilla perfume for both women and men. It starts with a creamy vanilla with gentle spices, which is rich and smooth. There is a gentle, floral touch that scoots in slowly, then falls into a praline and musky bottom. The smell is warm, a little bit spicy, and very lovely, which suits those who are fond of sweet and warm perfumes.

products.title: Lattafa Her Confession Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Her Confession Eau de Parfum is a new and charming perfume for women launched in 2024 by Lattafa. It is a warm, feminine scent that blends floral, sweet and musky notes beautifully. The perfume starts with a fiery touch of Mystikal and Cinnamon, then goes to a soft floral heart composed of Tuberose, Jasmine, Incense, and Mahonial. The perfume takes a smooth fall into a base of Vanilla, Musk, and Tonka thereby developing a creamy and cozy finish that is both elegant and modern at the same time.

products.title: Riiffs Golden Elixir Reserve Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Golden Elixir Reserve Eau de Parfum is a creamy and warm unisex perfume from Riiffs Perfumes. Launched in 2024, it is a sweet, spicy scent profile built with cinnamon, cognac, cardamom and coffee in the opening; praline, dates and tonka bean in the heart and a deep base of vanilla, agarwood and musk.

products.title: Ajmal Silver Shade Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Silver Shade Eau De Parfum is a fresh, modern, and energetic unisex fragrance that feels like a cool mountain breeze in a bottle. This scent is designed for the stylish individual who loves a clean and uplifting aroma. It beautifully balances zesty citrus fruits with soft florals and a clean, musky base, creating a perfectly refreshing and sophisticated experience.

Silver Shade smells yet smooth, with a touch of class that makes it incredibly versatile. It’s the perfect choice for anyone who wants a signature scent that is easy to wear daily but still makes a statement. A spray of Ajmal Silver Shade will leave you feeling confident, fresh, and ready to conquer your day with effortless style.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is an elegant oriental fragrance for both men and women. Inspired by rich Arabic traditions and royal gatherings, this scent wraps you in warmth, sweetness, and a soft floral touch.

Bin Shaikh combines the beauty of fresh roses, exotic saffron, and earthy oak moss with a sweet heart of bakhoor, sugar, jasmine, and violet. The dry down is deep and comforting with oud, amber, ambroxan, musk, and patchouli creating a luxurious trail.

Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is perfect for those who love sweet, woody scents with a hint of floral freshness. Just a few sprays make you feel confident, royal, and ready for any special moment.

products.title: Khadlaj Shiyaaka Shadow Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Shiyaaka Shadow Eau de Parfum is a bold, oriental, spicy male perfume that opens fresh and slightly sharp, featuring notes of grapefruit and pink pepper. A clean touch is added by lavender, followed by warmth and richness from amber and cedarwood. Patchouli, moss and musk are used in the dry down to form an even, long-lasting dark base. It is powerful, contemporary and suitable for self-confident men who prefer luxurious evening perfumes.

products.title: Versace Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette is a fresh and strong men’s fragrance that feels clean, modern, and confident. It opens with a cool splash of bergamot, grapefruit, and watery notes that feel very fresh on skin. Slowly, it moves into a spicy and slightly woody heart with black pepper and ambroxan. The base feels warm and smooth with musk, incense, and tonka bean. This scent feels masculine, stylish, and perfect for daily wear.

products.title: Calvin Klein Ck One Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein CK One Eau de Toilette is one of the most famous unisex perfume in the world which was launched in 1994 it brings a fresh and clean vibe that feels natural on both men and women. The Fragrance starts with citrus fruits like lemon, bergamot and mandarin orange, mixed with pineapple, green notes, cardamom and papaya and the middle brings a soft floral touch with jasmine, violet, rose, freesia, lily of the valley, nutmeg and orris root. The base is warm and balanced with green tea, sandalwood, musk, cedar, oakmoss, amber and green accords. CK One is simple, cool and made for everyday wear.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and modern scent made for men who like simple but classy perfumes. It begins with very refreshing minty and juicy citrus with a cool feeling and lots of energy. It gradually goes to soft and spicy middle notes that are then followed by smooth and soft woody and musky base notes that remain on the skin.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau De Parfum is a classy and modern women’s fragrance that feels fresh, soft, and slightly sweet. It opens with a clean lavender and juicy orange feel that smells bright and confident. Slowly, white flowers like orange blossom and jasmine come out and feel smooth and feminine. The vanilla and musk base makes it warm and long lasting. This scent feels elegant, bold, and perfect for confident women.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette is one of the most talked-about scents in the men’s fragrance world which was released in 2015 it has a sharp, fresh and bold profile that combines fruity, floral and woody notes in one bottle. The perfume starts with a blast of lemon, pineapple, bergamot, black currant and apple giving a citrusy yet sweet start. The middle slowly brings in smoky birch, soft jasmine and gentle rose. The endnotes are smooth and long-lasting with musk, ambergris, patchouli and a touch of vanilla which adds warmth and depth.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blu Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blue Oud Eau de Parfum is a unisex signature perfume from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. Launched in 2024, it is a bold take on a fresh and woody DNA profile consisting of leather, bergamot, and cypress (top notes); geranium and violet leaf (heart notes); and agarwood, patchouli, and musk (base notes) mixed seamlessly into a smooth composition with classic Middle Eastern accords of oud, incense, and guaiac wood.

products.title: Armaf Club De Nuit Sillage Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club De Nuit Sillage Eau De Parfum is a unisex fragrance launched in 2020. It is a bright and fresh perfume that opens with citrus and fruity notes of bergamot, lemon, black currant, lime, violet leaf, and ginger. The middle notes are soft florals like rose, iris, and jasmine and the final notes settle into a classy combination of ambroxan, musk, sandalwood, and cedar. It is a fragrance that feels clean, modern, and versatile, perfect for everyday wear or special evenings.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Oud & Roses Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Oud & Roses is a unisex fresh floriantel Eau de Parfum from the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house. It has a vibrant open of zesty lemon balanced by floral peony lavender and turkish rose, a heart of warm sandalwood, frankincense and white flowers and a musky-amber base mixed with oud, oakmoss, and guaiac wood.

products.title: Rue Broca Theoreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca Théoreme Eau de Parfum is a fresh, warm perfume for men, and simultaneously clean, spicy and smooth. It plays out with bright citrus that provides a sharp and energetic opening. Gradually, the amber and woody tones appear, bringing the warmth and richness. The musk, spices and patchouli in the dry down leave a strong and lasting trail. It is contemporary, secure and comfortable.

products.title: Lattafa Najdia Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Najdia Intense Eau de Parfum is a fresh and powerful men’s fragrance that feels vibrant and modern. The first impression is juicy pineapple and apple that bring a sweet, fruity kick, then slowly mint and ginger add a cool, spicy freshness. As it settles, marine notes and lavender give a clean feel, while tonka bean and sandalwood in the base create a smooth, warm finish that lasts for hours.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Marj Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Marj Eau de Parfum is a unisex floriental fragrance by the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house launched in 2023. It is a beautiful and graceful balance of numerous scent notes, which could have given messy results without fine blending. Marj has oud, honey, pink pepper, elemi, nutmeg, bergamot, and mandarin for its top layer; jasmine, cashmere wood, vetiver, orange blossom, cinnamon, patchouli, and saffron for the heart; and musk, ambergris, raspberry, oakmoss, saffron, pear, amber, agarwood, sandalwood, leather, and violet for the base of the composition.

products.title: Ajmal Blue Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Blue Homme Eau De Parfum was launched in 2013 by Ajmal fragrance house that is based in UAE as a fresh aquatic scent with a touch of citric and floral notes. It opens with Citric bergamot, flowery lavender and fruity watermelon; with time it diffuses off the top notes and the heart notes of Lotus and jasmine becomes more prominent and finally it has a soft and musky drydown with its amber, musk and sandalwood notes.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Soul of Bali Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Soul of Bali Extrait de Parfum is a tropical and spicy unisex scent that feels fresh, warm, and smooth. It opens with juicy mango, pineapple, rhubarb, and bergamot with a little ginger and pink pepper spice. The heart brings saffron, cardamom, and soft woody tones, while the base of ambergris, sandalwood, musk, and cypriol gives it a long-lasting warm finish. It is classy, bold, and easy to wear for many occasions.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Limited Edition Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Limited Edition Parfum is an intense, fresh, and smoky men's scent that is quite rich and elegant. Initially, it is composed of fresh lemon and pineapple that are shiny and harsh, and then little by little it becomes somewhat smoky and floral in the middle. Eventually, it gives a warm, musky, and woody smell to the skin. This fragrance has the traits of a bold, manly, and luxury scent that is appropriate for those men who enjoy strong and long-lasting perfumes that attract attention.

products.title: Paris Corner Marshmallow Blush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Marshmallow Blush Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet, unisex perfume. Launched in 2025, Paris Corner Marshmallow Blush Eau de Parfum is a playful and creamy scent profile made with fruity top notes of strawberry, raspberry and lemon; smooth heart notes of ambroxan and orange blossom and a fluffy sugary base of marshmallow and musk.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and modern unisex fragrance that beautifully blends fruity sweetness with soft floral touches and warm woody notes. Inspired by royalty and calm blue skies, this scent opens with juicy pear and sweet citrus notes that instantly lift your mood.

At its heart, Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum blooms with freesia and rose, giving a clean and graceful floral vibe. The base is warm and comforting with soft musk and smooth cedarwood, adding depth and a gentle touch of luxury that stays with you all day.

If you love fragrances that feel light yet royal, Azure Royal is a perfect choice for daily wear, special dinners, and every moment you want to feel fresh and confident.

products.title: French Avenue Aether Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Aether Extrait de Parfum is a cool and smooth perfume that targets both women and men. It begins with a pure fruit-like touch of green apple combined with fresh bergamot and mandarin that are refreshing and uplifting. Resting down, soft wood and violet emerge and give the smell a tranquil and harmonious smell. The foundation is musky and a little earthy, leaving a natural and long lasting finish, which is easy to wear and modern.

products.title: Lattafa Badee al Oud Noble Blush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Noble Blush Eau de Parfum is a soft, creamy, and elegant perfume made for women who love a sweet and warm scent. It starts with the gentle smell of rose milk, creating a smooth floral opening that feels cozy and romantic. The middle brings meringue and almond, adding a sweet, creamy note that feels like soft dessert air. The dry down is a mixture of vanilla, musk, and sandalwood that is serene, creamy, and slightly woody; thus, it is perfect for day and night.

products.title: Jaguar Classic Black Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jaguar Classic Black Eau De Toilette is a smooth, fresh, and slightly warm men’s fragrance that combines fruits, spices, and deep woody notes. It opens with crisp apple and bright citrus that feel clean and sharp. In the middle, you get tea, sea breeze notes, and soft spices that give a cool and calming vibe. The base is warm with musk, cedarwood, sandalwood, and tonka bean, making it soft, sweet, and classy. It is a simple, everyday masculine scent that feels modern, clean, and comforting.

products.title: Lattafa Yara Tous Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Yara Tous Eau de Parfum is a sweet, playful and creamy women’s perfume that feels bright and warm at the same time. It opens with juicy mango, soft coconut and a little passionfruit that gives a tropical feeling. The heart brings jasmine, orange blossom and heliotrope, making it floral and soft. The dry down settles into a sweet and cozy mix of vanilla, musk and cashmeran that stays on skin like a warm hug.

products.title: Khadlaj Cream Velvet Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Cream Velvet Extrait de Parfum is a warm and sweet unisex perfume that is touchy, rich and comfortable. It begins with creamy buttery caramel, which smells creamy and smooth on the initial spray. Then honey and tonka begin to glare, to be a deep sweet heart with a little flowery touch of jasmine. Vanilla, musk and amber fill the dry down and therefore, make it lasting and warm. It is fancy, contemporary and just ideal for those who are fond of sweet gourmand perfumes.

products.title: Creed Aventus Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Aventus Eau de Parfum was launched in 2010 and was composed by French perfumers Jean-Christophe Hérault and Erwin Creed. It has been formulated multiple times since its release in order to achieve its current balanced and seamless concentration.  
Creed Aventus EDP for men has been chosen as the winner for the prestigious Best Fragrance of the Year—Basenotes Readers’ Awards (2011–2014) and Top 10 Fragrances of All Time—based on the user votes.

products.title: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bade’e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance with a smooth and elegant oriental vanilla scent. Launched in 2021, it opens with fresh and spicy top notes of pink pepper and bergamot, followed by the floral heart of Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose, and jasmine. The base is rich and warm with agarwood (oud), amber, and vanilla.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Safa Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Safa Perfume is an easy-going, a bit romantic, and modern ladies' scent that gives off the impression of being both refreshing and warm simultaneously. The first note to reveal itself is the almost intoxicating mixture of juicy lychee and red fruits along with a barely perceptible touch of nuttiness, which is all very cheerful and silky. With the time passing, one can feel the soft floral notes of rose and magnolia on the skin, and they are nothing but classy. The dry-down is a lovely combination of vanilla and gourmand notes that create a feel of warmth and creaminess, which is so comforting that it lingers for many hours.

products.title: Kayali Vanilla 28 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Vanilla 28 is a warm, sweet, and cosy fragrance that feels very smooth on the skin. The opening is soft vanilla orchid with a little bit of jasmine that feels gentle and creamy. Time passes and the smell becomes sweeter with the addition of brown sugar and tonka bean that create a deep and comforting sensation. The foundation is filled with amber, amberwood, musk, and patchouli, which provide a long-lasting warm glow that is very close to the skin. This scent is sweet, feminine, but also unisex, and thus it appeals to those who like soft and inviting, rich vanilla.

products.title: Afnan Mystique Bouquet Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Mystique Bouquet Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and very feminine fragrance made for women who love fresh floral scents with a fruity touch. It was perfumed in 2024. This perfume starts with a cheerful and playful opening of bright and juicy fruits. Gentle flowers that make the scent clean and elegant come through as the fragrance settles. The base is warm and creamy, with a hint of sweetness, making the scent comforting and long lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Hayati Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Hayati Black Eau De Parfum is a bold and smooth unisex perfume made for people who love a classy yet modern scent. The opening part is bright and fruity due to the juicy scent of apple and bergamot. Then the heart warms us with the spiciness of cinnamon and woody notes, thus giving us depth and comfort. At last, the base composed of musk and vanilla delivers a smooth and creamy finish that is long-lasting, elegant and beautiful all day long.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Mahad Al Dahab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Mahad Al Dahab Eau de Parfum is a creamy and warm unisex perfume made for people who love deep oriental scents. Launched in 2025, this fragrance feels luxurious and strong but still smooth. It opens with fresh citrus and spicy notes, then slowly moves into a warm heart of amber, patchouli and oud. The dry down is creamy and soft with vanilla, sandalwood and white musk, which stays close to skin and feels very elegant.

products.title: Lattafa Musamam White Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Musamam White Intense Eau De Parfum is a warm and creamy unisex fragrance, which is smooth to the touch and a bit sweet. The introduction is a fresh combination of bergamot, orange and soft spices, which createsa bright but warm introduction. Gradually, coconut and ylang ylang blend into a rich and soothing creamy floral heart. The musk and sandalwood foundation gives the skin a rich, warm woody fragrance that lingers in the skin for many hours. This perfume is classy, contemporary and suited to those who like warm oriental perfumes with a smooth twist.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Parfum
products.body_html:
Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Parfum stands as a modern, profound interpretation of the legendary Acqua Di Gio collection. It masterfully achieves balance by merging the invigorating freshness of marine notes with the inherent richness of woody undertones, resulting in a fragrance that projects both purity and significant power. 

The opening sequence delivers the bright, airy freshness of marine notes and bergamot, creating an initial impression reminiscent of a clean sea breeze and crisp citrus. This evolves into an aromatic core of rosemary, clary sage, and geranium, which introduces a distinct herbal depth. Finally, the scent anchors itself with warm notes of olibanum and patchouli, providing a grounded, lasting, and deeply masculine trail. Crafted by master perfumer Alberto Morillas, this fragrance is built on a foundation of clean, confident, and enduring sophistication, making it an ideal choice for the man who values an effortlessly elegant and timeless scent.

products.title: Armaf Odyssey Limoni Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Odyssey Limoni Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance that is fresh, pure, and luminous. It is characterized by an intense citrus opening of lemon, orange, mandarin, and bergamot that is very revitalizing and vigorous. Then, the ginger gives a smooth fresh feel to the orange blossom and light marine notes, which are soft in character. The underlying tea, musk, and amber create a composed and uncomplicated fragrance that is ideal for everyday use and warm days.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Opulence Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Opulence Eau de Parfum is a rich and smooth oriental floral scent made for both men and women. Launched in 2025, this perfume feels classy, warm and modern at the same time. It opens with a juicy pear mixed with fresh bergamot and a little spicy ginger, which feels bright and clean. The heart is soft and floral with orange blossom and jasmine, balanced by gentle woody notes. As it dries down, vanilla, musk and amber come together to give a warm, sweet and cozy feel.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum is a daring and opulent scent for women that appears to be a rich blend of warm and mildly sweet. Initially, it shows the fresh explosion of ginger, saffron, and citrus notes that provide a spicy and exhilarating start. The middle of orange blossom and lavender contributes a delicate and floral scent, while the bottom of bourbon vanilla, honey, tonka bean, and vetiver gives a creamy and very lasting smelly cloud. This perfume smells contemporary, assertive, and suitable for the ladies who enjoy warm and classy scents.

products.title: Afnan Historic Olemeda Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Historic Olemeda Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume from the house of Afnan which was released in 2022. It is built around a fresh and spicy DNA with sparkling citrus, spices and woody accords. The perfume starts with grapefruit, pink pepper, juniper and cardamom, all are the top notes of this perfume. The middle notes are Calabrian bergamot, cedar, nutmeg and jasmine and the final notes are ambergris, apple, musk and patchouli for a deep long-lasting impression. This fragrance is designed as a versatile everyday signature with a balance of fresh energy and warm sensuality.

products.title: Lattafa Suqraat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Suqraat Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and slightly spicy men’s perfume from the house of Lattafa. It opens with bright bergamot and warm ginger, then moves into soft lavender and green violet leaf. The scent finishes with smooth musk, creamy sandalwood and a hint of warm amber.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy in Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy in Heaven Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean, and classy fragrance for men who love to feel cool and confident. Inspired by clear blue skies and a fresh breeze, Afnan Supremacy in Heaven brings together citrus and green notes with a smooth woody base.

This fragrance feels like wearing a crisp white shirt on a sunny day, simple yet very sophisticated. With every spray of Afnan Supremacy in Heaven, you get a burst of fresh bergamot and mandarin orange, followed by soothing green tea and black currant. The base of musk and sandalwood keeps it soft, clean, and long-lasting.

Perfect for everyday wear or special occasions when you want to smell fresh, neat, and modern.

products.title: Nusuk Raheeq Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Raheeq Extrait de Parfum is a creamy, sweet, warm perfume made for both men and women. It opens with juicy and honey like notes of honey, blood orange, apricot and lemon, which give a fruity, sweet start. The heart comes creamy and tasty with coconut, caramel and soft magnolia. The dry down feels smooth and cozy with vanilla absolute, musk and sandalwood.

products.title: Riiffs Fleurie Emerald Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Fleurie Emerald Eau de Parfum is a sweet and elegant women's perfume. Launched in 2025, it features a creamy, oriental vanilla scent profile made from juicy blood orange, lemon peel and lavender (top notes); soft white flowers, licorice, cinnamon and anise (middle notes) and creamy caramel, vanilla bean and musk (base notes). All notes blend harmoniously to create a smooth, warm, slightly sweet fragrance that feels classy yet still playful and modern.

products.title: Afnan Delicious Bouquet Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Delicious Bouquet Eau de Parfum is a bright and citrus scent crafted for women who love sweet, creamy and sparkling fragrances which is launched in 2025 it brings together a combination of zesty lemon and bergamot with smooth vanilla and white flowers at the opening. The middle shines with notes of rum, sugar, orange blossom, honey and whipped cream giving it a delicious dessert like feel. The final notes are caramel, tonka, musk and creamy vanilla wrapping the scent into a long-lasting sweet trail that feels both joyful and addictive.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Si Fiori Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Si Fiori EDP feels like your favourite light dress on a perfect spring day – simple, pretty, and makes you smile the second you put it on. Right when you spray, black currant and green mandarin hit you with this juicy, happy pop, like fruit straight from the market. Then it softens into neroli and rose that smell fresh-picked, with just a whisper of patchouli and oakmoss to keep it real. Vanilla and white musk hug you at the end, warm but never heavy. Julie Massé cooked this up in 2019 to say, “hey, be you, even when the city’s loud”. Perfume fans rave about how easy it is to wear all day, sweet enough to lift your mood, light enough to never bug anyone.

products.title: Riiffs Prive Rose Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Prive Rose Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and romantic floral women’s perfume for those who love elegant rose perfumes. Launched in 2023, this fragrance opens with juicy plum, which feels slightly fruity and fresh. The middle is full of rose petals and peony, giving it a creamy floral touch that smells clean, smooth and very feminine. The base settles into warm ambroxan, creamy vanilla and soft musk, which makes the scent feel cozy and long lasting.

products.title: Khadlaj Fursan White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Fursan White Eau de Parfum is a perfume used by women. Fursan White was launched in 2024. Bergamot and Jasmine are the top notes, Musk, Coconut and Almond are the middle notes, and Vanilla, Cedarwood and Nutmeg are the base notes. It starts with fresh bergamot and a slight touch of jasmine that is clean and bright. After several minutes, coconut and almond arrive, adding musk to it, making it feel milk-like. Vanilla, cedarwood and nutmeg are present in the dry down to provide a warm and soft spicy feel. It is stylish, comfortable and highly comfortable.

products.title: Lattafa Art of Universe Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Art of Universe is a new female and male citrus aromatic perfume. This is a new fragrance. The Art of Universe was introduced in 2025. The aroma starts with fresh mandarin, bergamot, mint and a spicy touch of ginger. Pear and orange blossom are used in the heart to add some soft sweetness and smoothness. Musk, amber and cedar base provide a warm woody finish which remains well-behaved on the skin hours later.

products.title: Prada Paradoxe Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: In the world of perfume, Prada Paradoxe Eau De Parfum is one of the certainly women's fragrances that are soft, fresh, and modern that smell clean and elegant. Fresh fruity accords of pear and citrus notes with their bright and smooth character immediately attract attention. Very gently, the white flowers likened to orange blossom and jasmine take the front, thus creating a creamy and feminine aura. At the end of the day, vanilla and amber bring in warmth and softness that remain on the skin for a long time. The whole fragrance is classy, soft, and ideal for everyday use.

products.title: Khadlaj Karus Secret Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Karus Secret Musk Eau de Parfum is a warm and sweet unisex perfume that is smooth and slightly creamy. It begins with a sweet spicy saffron and juicy red fruits then gradually switches to a rich tonka bean, rose and chocolate heart that is warm and deep. The musky and amber base remains on the skin for long hours with a soft and noticeable mark. It is contemporary, daring and somewhat addictive.

products.title: Issey Miyake L'eau D'issey Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Issey Miyake L’Eau D’Issey Pour Homme is a fresh, clean, and uplifting perfume for men with a gentle woody touch. It opens with bright citrus notes like yuzu, lemon, mandarin and bergamot that feel very crisp and refreshing. The middle brings a combination of spicy nutmeg, saffron, cinnamon and soft florals like blue lotus and lily-of-the-valley that give a smooth balance. As it dries down, it turns warm, woody and a bit musky with vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, amber and a soft tobacco note. It is a timeless, everyday fragrance that feels light, natural and very easy to wear.

products.title: Nusuk Sama Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Sama Eau de Parfum is a fresh and airy unisex perfume from the house of Nusuk. It was introduced in 2025 and has a light, cool and refreshing clean aquatic style. The fragrance begins with the fresh and luminous scent of lemon and bergamot. Heart mixes sage, geranium and ozonic notes, which are breezy and herbal to some extent. The base settles into soft moss, musk and light amber, creating a smooth and relaxing finish that stays gentle on skin and pleasant in the air.

products.title: Lattafa Velvet Rose Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Velvet Rose Eau De Parfum is a soft, warm and romantic floral scent made for both men and women. It starts with a sweet and fresh rose along with a small amount of patchouli on top. The scent in the middle becomes smooth with musk and labdanum, which adds a delightful amber type feel to it. The dry down end of the fragrance is calm, warm and slightly creamy with musk and amber that lasts close to your skin for a long time.

products.title: Lattafa Petra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Petra Eau de Perrier by Lattafa Perfumes is a creamy and sweet unisex perfume that is warm and a tad bit boozy. The initial spray introduces the splendid rum and juicy plum, which add a dark fruity touch to this spray. Then there comes tuberose and coconut, and it is soft and creamy. The smooth sweet finish of vanilla, musk and praline in the base remains hours long.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Zeleny Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Zeleny Eau de Parfum is a fresh and vibrant unisex perfume. Launched in 2023, it opens with a juicy and fruity burst of grapefruit, tangerine, strawberry and pineapple. The middle notes is floral with jasmine, orchid, peony and a touch of vanilla. Finally, it develops into a warm and luxurious base of oakmoss, musk and woody notes, leaving a smooth and lasting scent suitable for all events.

products.title: Nusuk Mahab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Mahab Eau de Parfum is a new unisex floral scent from Nusuk Fragrances. Released in 2025, it offers a soft, fruity floral style, with light smoky and musky tones. The opening starts with incense, fennel, and sweet red fruits, giving a slightly warm and juicy feel. The heart blooms with peach, osmanthus and jasmine, which smells smooth and floral. The base settles into sandalwood, rose, and musk that feels creamy, gentle and long lasting on skin.

products.title: Lattafa Nebras Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nebras Elixir by Lattafa is an Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Nebras Elixir was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Nanako Ogi. Top notes are Milk Candy and Whipped Cream; middle notes are Sugar Cane and Heliotrope; base notes are Vanilla, Ambroxan and Musk.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Precieux I Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: The Armaf Club de Nuit Precieux I Extrait de Parfum is a vibrant and strong perfume suitable for both genders. The perfume has a very fruity, fresh and lively opening of pineapple, lemon and bergamot, mixed with a delicate sweetness of caramel. Gradually it transforms to a woody and mild spicy smell, and finally it is deep, warm, and smooth with amber, leather and vanilla. The fragrance has an aura of elegance, daring, and persistence.

products.title: Ajmal Silver Shade Homme Deodrant
products.body_html: Ajmal SILVERSHADE HOMME Deodorant is a 200ml non-alcoholic body spray designed for men who value invigorating freshness and modern style. This dynamic fresh deodorant opens with an uplifting blend of citrus and fruity notes, instantly energising your senses. The heart reveals aromatic florals paired with cool spices, adding a sophisticated layer. A base of soft woods and musk ensures a smooth, lasting finish that feels clean and assured.

products.title: Lattafa Teriaq Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Teriaq Eau de Parfum is a new fragrance for men and women released in 2024. It is a sweet, warm fragrance that feels playful at first and then turns rich and deep as it settles. It opens with caramel, apricot, almond and a little pink pepper spark. In the heart you get honey, soft white flowers, rose and a touch of rhubarb. The base is warm and cozy with leather, vanilla, labdanum, musk and vetiver.

products.title: Lattafa Ansaam Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ansaam Gold Eau de Parfum is a rich oriental floral perfume designed for women who love warm and sweet scents. The perfume opens with a soft and fruity mixture of Mandarin Orange and Pear, then the heart of Jasmine, Rose, and sweet notes wrap the fragrance giving it a smooth and creamy touch. The base is Vanilla, Musk, and Raspberry that impart a warm sweetness which is very beautifully intimate with the skin.

products.title: Lalique Encre Noire Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Encre Noire Lalique EDP for men is a dark, woody, and mysterious fragrance that is perfect for evening and special occasions. It opens with a fresh and green cypress note, followed by a heart of smooth vetiver, and settles into a rich, warm base of cashmere wood and musk. Created by Nathalie Lorson in 2006, this fragrance is loved for its deep, masculine aroma and long-lasting scent.

products.title: French Avenue Pinnace White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Pinnace White Eau de Parfum from French Avenue Fragrances is a fresh, bright and easy to wear perfume for women who enjoy clean, fruity scents. This perfume was introduced in 2024 and starts with sticky sweet citrus that is fresh and joyful. The heart adds a soft green, fruity touch, while the base settles into a smooth, musky finish. French Avenue Pinnace White Eau de Parfum feels light, modern and perfect for daily wear without being heavy or loud.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Uhud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Uhud Eau de Parfum, the vanilla fragrance that is sweet and warm, is created for men and women alike. The perfume starts with a powerful combination of caramel and red fruits along with a delicate rose note that is sweet and enticing. The honey, tonka, and raspberry slowly come forward and turn the scent into a creamy and smooth one. In the base, vanilla, white musk, and amber linger on the skin for a long time and feel warm and sophisticated.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Muzn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Muzn is a unisex fruity-aquatic Eau de Parfum from the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house. It is a vibrant Middle Eastern summer captured in a blend of scents. The playful fruity notes of melon and fruits mixed with sea salt give it its iconic flavor. The musky heart with sandalwood and amber at the base gives it a smooth and lingering drydown.

products.title: Nautica Voyage Sport Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Nautica Voyage Sport Eau de Toilette is a fresh, sporty men’s perfume from Nautica Fragrances. It is a clean ocean style scent made with sea notes, citrus and sea salt in the opening; apple, geranium, palm leaf and green pepper in the middle; and musk, vetiver, patchouli and Brazilian redwood in the base. The smell feels fresh, salty, green and a little woody, giving a cool beach day vibe that is easy to wear and not heavy.

products.title: Mancera Instant Crush Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Instant Crush Eau De Parfum is a warm, bright and spicy unisex scent that mixes sweet florals with fresh citrus and deep musky notes. The scent opens strong with saffron, ginger, mandarin and bergamot, giving a bold and shiny start. In the middle, you get amberwood, Moroccan rose, Egyptian jasmine and patchouli leaf that add a soft but rich touch. The dry down of vanilla, white musk, sandalwood and oakmoss makes the perfume smooth, creamy and long-lasting.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Felicity Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Felicity Eau de Parfum is a soft, pretty and happy feeling women’s perfume for those who like sweet floral perfumes. It begins with the bubbly, fruity smell of champagne, cassis and freesia that are fresh and a bit sparkling. The middle is light jasmine, rose and musk that is clean and feminine. The dry down is warm, creamy and sugary with vanilla and musk, leaving a soft, sweet scent that lingers near and comforting.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Aqua Dubai Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Aqua Dubai Eau de Parfum is a fresh and vibrant unisex perfume. It mixes fruity, green and warm amber notes to create a modern everyday scent. The opening feels juicy and bright with bergamot, green notes and mandarin orange. The heart becomes sweet and tropical with melon, black currant and pineapple mixed with smooth amber. The base is soft and creamy with musk, petitgrain, galbanum and vanilla, giving a long lasting finish.

products.title: Lattafa Raaed Luxe Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Raaed Luxe Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and spicy fragrance for men and women that opens with juicy fruits and fresh florals. It blends watermelon, pineapple, pink pepper and jasmine at the top. The middle brings herbal notes, soft lavender, sage and a light touch of cinnamon. The dry down becomes cozy with vanilla, musk, sandalwood, chestnut, vetiver, strawberry and tonka bean.

products.title: Ajmal Sacred Love Femme Deodrant
products.body_html: Ajmal SACRED LOVE Deodorant is a 200ml non-alcoholic women’s body spray that celebrates femininity and grace. This exquisite Ajmal Sacred Love deodorant opens with a refreshing blend of citrus and delicate fruits, creating an uplifting first impression. The heart blossoms into a lush bouquet of florals, perfectly balanced by warm woody and musky undertones that linger beautifully on the skin.

products.title: Versace Pour Homme Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Pour Homme Eau de Toilette is a refreshing and pure fragrance for men that feels very light, soft, and comfortable on the skin. The opening note consists of a fresh citrus that is very vivid and uplifting. Gradually, the scent becomes aromatic and gentle with a clean woody character. This scent is uncomplicated, elegant, and ideal for everyday use. It is for those men who appreciate a subtle scent that is always fresh, soothing, and contemporary yet never overstated or oppressive.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Summer Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Summer Oud Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance from Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. Launched in 2022, it is a refreshing and warm scent with a perfect summer vibe. The scent has a bright and fresh opening formed by the very top notes of saffron, mandarin orange, incense and cypriol. The fragrance then gets warmer and sweeter thanks to the middle notes of rose, cashmere wood, caramel, amber and patchouli. The skin is then treated with a long lasting, rich and smooth trail created by the base of oud, leather, musk, oakmoss and vetiver.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Gold Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Gold Eau De Parfum is a beautiful unisex perfume that mixes floral, fruity and warm oriental notes. The opening consists of red berries, peach and bergamot that are very sweet and juicy so they create a fresh and playful start. The heart reveals soft blossom of jasmine, peony and red lily. Then, the base of sandalwood, vanilla flower and musk create a creamy and warm dry-down that is become smart and long-lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Habik Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Habik Eau de Parfum For Men is a strong aromatic perfume, which is fresh, spicy and warm simultaneously. It starts bright with bergamot and pepper that have a sharp and clean feel. Lavender and cinnamon creep in slowly, bringing the cool comfort. During the dry down, tonka bean and sandalwood render it creamy and a little sweet. It reeks contemporary, powerful, and assertive, an ideal smell to men who appreciate audacious but refined fragrances.

products.title: Riiffs Prive Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Prive Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh aromatic scent for men who like clean, bold, and stylish perfumes. Released in 2025, it opens with spicy, crisp tones of Sichuan pepper, green apple and tobacco that feel energetic and modern. The heart brings soft violet, patchouli and cacao, which add a smooth and slightly sweet depth. The base settles into warm Madagascar vanilla, leather and labdanum, giving a creamy, masculine finish that feels classy yet easy to wear daily.

products.title: Mancera  Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum is a deeper, more decadent version of the original Cedrat Boise. This Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum feels bolder, smoother and more long lasting on the skin. It starts with fresh citrus aromas, blended with black currant and spice, for a sharp, classy opening. Leather, sandalwood, oud, patchouli and jasmine all intertwine and combine to form a warm, rather smoky heart as it settles. It is creamy, musky at the base, contains ambergris, oakmoss, vanilla and white musk and lasts hours and hours on the skin.

products.title: Dumont Nitro White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro White Eau de Parfum is a stylish and modern scent made for confident men. Launched in 2024, it opens with a clean, fresh touch of Juniper Berries, Iris and Cypress, which give it a cool and classy start. The middle adds Myrrh and Patchouli which offer a smooth and deep warmth. And the base combination of Honey, Vanilla, Amber, Musk and Leather provides a strong, masculine and comforting finish.

products.title: Ajmal Musk Silk Supreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Musk Silk Supreme Eau de Parfum is a soft, clean and elegant unisex fragrance from the house of Ajmal Scents. This perfume is all about smooth musk blended with gentle floral and warm amber tones. It opens with a fresh and calming touch of lily of the valley, giving a clean and airy feel. As it settles, creamy musk takes over and stays close to the skin, making it comforting and classy. The warm amber and extra musk in the base contribute to the longevity of the fragrance and create a cozy feeling around it.

products.title: Jaguar Classic Gold Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jaguar Classic Gold Eau De Toilette is a warm, woody, and fresh men’s fragrance that feels smooth and classy. It opens with a juicy combination of apple, bergamot and lime that gives a sharp bright start. Soon, the scent turns softer with orange blossom and teak wood, giving it a sweet woody middle. In the dry down, vanilla, patchouli and musk add a warm creamy finish that feels very comforting. It is simple, elegant, and a perfect everyday scent that feels clean and confident.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum is a glamorous fragrance for women that mixes bold dark notes with bright and sweet floral tones. Launched in 2016, this perfume became iconic not only for its scent but also for its stylish stiletto-shaped bottle. The fragrance opens with almond, coffee, bergamot, and lemon for a rich and addictive start. The heart blooms with tuberose, jasmine sambac, orange blossom, Bulgarian rose, and orris. The base is deep and warm with tonka bean, cacao, vanilla, praline, sandalwood, musk, amber, cashmere wood, patchouli, cinnamon, and cedar. Together, it creates a scent that feels powerful yet feminine, daring yet elegant.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Fusion Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Fusion Eau de Parfum is a fresh, fruity, floral unisex scent from Paris Corner fragrances. It starts with juicy, sweet fruits such as litchi, red apple, black currant and a hint of zesty Italian lemon, which makes it bright and playful. The heart opens gradually with gentle jasmine sambac, romantic Taif rose and powdery pansy fragrances that are smooth and light. The base settles into warm, creamy vanilla, musk, sandalwood, cedar and the smell is comfortable, sweet and long lasting with a soft, woody finish.

products.title: Montale Intense Cafe Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Intense Café Eau De Parfum is a warm, sweet and cozy unisex scent that merges smooth coffee, soft rose and creamy vanilla. It was launched in 2013 and has that calm café vibe with a touch of sweetness and a gentle musky base.

products.title: French Avenue Royal Blend Nero Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Royal Blend Nero Extrait de Parfum is a bold, warm and spicy unisex fragrance made for people who like strong and wealthy scents. It opens with a fresh yet spicy mix of nutmeg, apple and bergamot that feels smooth and classy. The middle brings heat and depth with cinnamon, dry woods and saffron, giving it a dark, royal touch. The base is sweet, creamy and long lasting with vanilla, tonka bean, benzoin and musk.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette is a cheerful, fresh, fun and lively women’s fragrance that literally encapsulates summer. Light Blue opens bright and transparent with a shocking burst of Sicilian lemon, Granny Smith apple, cedar, and soft bellflower akin to the scent of an early cool morning soft breeze; incredibly pleasant! Light Blue has a slight playful nature, while bamboo, jasmine, and rose enhance its buoyancy and elegance. Light Blue dries down smooth and enjoyable with cedarwood, clean musk, and a gentle bit of amber, leaving a subtle but long-lasting impression on your skin.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum for Men is a delightful fragrance that masterfully communicates the spicy and sweet notes in its own classy way. The first impression consists of black pepper, lavender, and bergamot, which provide the freshness, after which the heart notes of orris, cloves, and cinnamon give the warmth. The base consists of the very deep and sophisticated notes of black vanilla husk, tolu balsam, tonka bean, benzoin, and patchouli.

products.title: Al Haramain L'aventure Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Al Haramain L'aventure Eau De Parfum is a fresh, confident, and magnetic fragrance for the modern man who loves adventure. This perfume is an amazing blend of fresh citrus, rich woods, and warm musk that creates a memorable scent experience. It smells like success and confidence in a bottle.

L'aventure is incredibly versatile and loved for its ability to draw compliments. It’s perfect for the man who wants a signature scent that is both energetic and elegant. One spray of Al Haramain L'aventure makes you feel ready to conquer the day, whether you're in a business meeting or on a weekend trip.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Not a Perfume Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Not a Perfume Eau de Parfum is a soft and non-polluting perfume for women. This fragrance was introduced in 2010 and was produced by Romano Ricci using only one note, which is Cetalox. It is light, musky, and a little woody with a refreshing feel on the skin. It is incorporated with your natural perfume and is a casual, contemporary, and comfortable daily wear.

products.title: Afnan Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum is a sweet, warm, and dreamy fragrance made for women who love to feel soft and beautiful. Launched in 2024, this perfume brings together creamy vanilla with tropical coconut and delicious caramel for a scent that feels like a warm hug. The gentle touch of Palo Santo adds a hint of calm woodiness, while the base of white musk and sandalwood gives a smooth and cozy finish.

Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum is perfect for women who enjoy fragrances that are sweet yet elegant. Every spray wraps you in a blissful, creamy cloud that lasts for hours and keeps you feeling fresh and confident all day long.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Eau De Parfum is a clean, soft, and refreshing unisex scent that feels simple yet very elegant. It opens with bright citrusy notes of bergamot and orange, giving a fresh and uplifting start. In the middle of the fragrance are vanilla and pear, which produce a very smooth and creamy sweetness and are very pleasant to smell. At last, it is the warm musk and amber in the base that make it cozy, last a long time, and are suitable for daily use.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum is the new-age scent of modern confidence. It’s a fragrance that celebrates being your true self, fresh, clean, and effortlessly stylish. Created for the man who is not afraid to show his sensitive side, this perfume beautifully combines bright citrus with a clean floral heart and a warm, woody base.

YSL Myslf is incredibly versatile and easy to wear. It’s the perfect companion for every part of your day, from a busy morning at the office to a relaxed evening with friends. A spray of Yves Saint Laurent Myslf feels like putting on your favorite crisp shirt, it gives you a boost of freshness and makes you feel put-together and ready for anything.

products.title: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau De Parfum is a bold, dark and rich women’s perfume. Black Orchid was launched in 2006 and was created by David Apel and Pierre Negrin. It opens with deep and slightly sweet notes that feel warm and luxurious. As it settles, floral and spicy tones come out slowly and smoothly. The base feels creamy, chocolatey and woody, which stays on the skin for long hours.

products.title: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette is a unisex fragrance that blends fresh, floral, and woody notes to create a calm and natural vibe. Launched in 1996, it opens with a combination of lavender, citrus, and mint for a fresh start. The middle notes have soft floral and green notes like jasmine, peach, and magnolia. The base is warm and comforting with musk, sandalwood, cedar, vanilla, and amber, giving a smooth finish for everyday wear.

products.title: Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette is a fresh, soft, and very feminine perfume made for women who love light and clean scents. It opens with a fresh mix of yuzu and pomegranate that feels juicy and bright. Slowly, the floral heart of peony, lotus, and magnolia comes out and feels smooth and gentle. The base of musk and amber gives a soft warmth that stays close to skin. This perfume feels elegant, fresh, and perfect for daily wear.

products.title: Rayhaan Ocean Rush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Ocean Rush Eau de Parfum is a fresh, aquatic style scent for men who like clean, energetic fragrances. Launched in 2024, it opens with a splash of watery, citrus notes like cascalone, bergamot, aquozone and mandarin that feel bright and breezy. The heart features herbal notes of lavender, cypress and rosemary, giving it a green aromatic feel. The dry down settles into warm amber, musk and patchouli, giving smooth, masculine depth.

products.title: French Avenue Moonstone Bleu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Moonstone Bleu Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume with a cool, clean and slightly dark feel. It opens with fresh watery and metallic notes mixed with peppery spice, giving a sharp and airy start. As it settles, soft florals, beeswax and leather come in, adding smooth warmth and depth. The base feels creamy and comforting with musk, honey, woods, and amber.

products.title: Lattafa Oud Mood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Oud Mood Eau De Parfum is a warm, rich and deep unisex perfume from the well-known house of Lattafa. It has a strong Middle Eastern touch with spicy, sweet and woody notes. The scent opens with a soft mix of rose, saffron and a little peppery pimento. In the middle, you get caramel, floral notes, patchouli and a beautiful oud tone that gives a dark and sweet feel. The dry down is warm with amber, resins, musk, incense and woody notes that stay long on skin and clothes.

products.title: Franck Olivier Oud Vanille Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Franck Olivier Oud Vanille Eau De Parfum is a warm, deep, and cozy smell. It feels rich right from the start. It mixes the smooth sweet of caramel and raspberry with a little fresh orange. This makes a creamy, nice opening. As it sits, the perfume infuses more. You get a flowery smell of rose, violet, and jasmine. This is mixed with patchouli and a bit of incense. It gives a soft, smoky, and mysterious feel. It is creamy, cozy, and a little spicy. It rests nicely on wood, musk, and spice smells. 

Franck Olivier Oud Vanille is the kind of scent that makes you feel wrapped up in luxury. It is not too loud. But people will notice you when you walk past. It is perfect for evenings or cold days. It leaves a sweet, deep smell that stays softly. This perfume is good for both men and women. It balances sweet, spice, and sexy smells well. It is not too strong.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Frost Ice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Frost Ice Eau de Parfum was launched in 2024 as a light and breezy unisex fragrance with refreshing citrus, bergamot, and mint top notes; aromatic spices, lavender, and geranium heart notes; and soft and warm musk, woods, and amber base notes. A couple of spritz of Frose Ice EDP in the morning keeps you refreshed and energized throughout the day.

products.title: Riiffs Areebah Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Areebah Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume from the house of Riiffs Perfumes. It is a creamy, oriental, woody scent that feels warm, sweet and a little exotic at the same time. The scent opens with fruity and spicy tones of tropical fruits, osmanthus and saffron. The middle notes include patchouli, frangipani and agarwood, which impart a creamy, woody feel. In the dry down, you get cedar, musk and Madagascar vanilla, which makes the fragrance smooth, soft and long lasting with a cozy trail.

products.title: Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum is an invigorating, sleek, and masculine perfume that radiates modernity and self-assurance. The scent starts off with a combination of icy oceanic notes, lavender and pink pepper, producing a fresh and subtly spicy introduction. The heart is very clean and has a soapy aspect due to the gentle green notes, whereas the base gets cosy and silky with the blend of musk, cashmere, and sandalwood. The fragrance is, in a way, athletic, powerful, and suited for day-to-day use.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Blueberry Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Blueberry Musk Eau de Parfum is a unisex delectable, fruity and soft musky aroma. Fresh, playful, and fruity, it starts with luscious blueberry and blackberry. Gradually, among the fruity and fresh notes, come the elegant and velvety floral notes of freesia, lavender, and rose. The base has a creamy and warm feel of vanilla, raspberry and soft woods. This perfume is characterized by its cosiness, modernity and daily wearability.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Vanilla Toffee Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Vanilla Toffee Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and comforting unisex fragrance made for people who love dessert style perfumes. It starts off with a powerful outburst of toffee and coffee that is melted and roasted and it gives a warm and friendly feeling. Meanwhile, the notes of vanilla and walnut, milk and dates become quite smooth and edible. The long lasting and the deep base consists of brown sugar, rich Madagascar vanilla, vanilla caviar, tonka bean, woody notes, benzoin and soft musk.

products.title: Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau De Parfum is an elegant men's scent that is dark, smooth, and modern. The fragrance starts off with a refreshing note of bergamot that is clean and sharp, but it later mixes with gentle angelica and deep patchouli. In the end, amber, musk, and coumarin create a dark, slightly sweet, and warm scent. This fragrance is self-assured, relaxed, and fashionable, which is why it is ideal for men who prefer classy and strong scents.

products.title: Ajmal  Eau d'Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Eau d'Oud Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance made for people who like fresh notes with a deep oud base. It opens with a clean and fresh mix of citrus, bergamot and mint, which feels bright and energetic. The middle is formed of the gentle flowers and the warm spices of such as neroli, ginger, rose and nutmeg that give it a smooth balance. The base settles into a creamy combination of oud, amber, musk and tonka bean, thus imparting warmth, comfort and longevity to the fragrance.

products.title: Byredo Bal D'afrique Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Byredo Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum is a warm and elegant unisex fragrance inspired by African culture and Parisian spirit. Launched in 2009, this scent beautifully combines citrus, floral, and woody notes in a smooth balance. It opens with fresh Amalfi lemon, marigold, bergamot, black currant, and African orange flower. The middle notes of violet, cyclamen, and jasmine give it a soft floral charm, while the base of vetiver, musk, amber, and Virginia cedar adds depth and long-lasting warmth.

products.title: Nautica Voyage N 83 Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Nautica Voyage N-83 Eau de Toilette is a fresh aquatic scent for men from the house of Nautica. It is inspired by ocean breezes and cool sea air, giving a clean sporty vibe. The scent opens with fresh sea notes, peppermint and petitgrain, moves into a soft, spicy heart of lavender, cardamom and nutmeg and settles into a smooth base of musk, cedar and sandalwood. The blend feels fresh, slightly spicy and woody at the same time, making it a very easy everyday men’s perfume for those who like clean marine scents.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Black Eau De Parfum is a bold and deep oriental scent made for both men and women. It starts with the spiciness of black pepper, pink pepper and saffron, which are all together giving a powerful and fresh beginning. The middle note combines smoky cade oil with labdanum, balsam and rhubarb for a dark, warm and rich feeling. Finally, the base of smooth leather, cedar, guaiac wood, patchouli, moss and musk creates a fragrant, lasting and classy perfume.

products.title: French Avenue Coco Morado Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Coco Morado Eau de Parfum is a bold and deep unisex fragrance for those who enjoy dark, sweet and woody scents.
