It opens with spicy warmth from cinnamon, saffron, nutmeg and ginger, which feels creamy and slightly sharp at first. As the perfume settles, you start getting heavy oud, incense, dates, caramel and amberwood notes that feel sweet, smoky and resin like. In the dry down, leather, vanilla, cacao butter, musk and patchouli come together to give a creamy, warm and long lasting base that feels luxurious and strong.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Parfum is a modern, romantic, and dazzling fragrance that feels like a passionate love affair in the city of Paris. It captures the intense feeling of falling in love. This beautiful scent opens with a sweet and juicy burst of red berries and pear, instantly making you feel happy and amazing. It then settles into a lovely heart of white flowers, creating a truly feminine and charming experience.

Mon Paris is for the woman who is passionate, modern, and lives freely. It is a perfect combination of sweet, floral, and warm notes that makes it incredibly easy to wear and love. One spray of Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris will envelop you in a beautiful aura of romance and elegance, making every moment feel truly special.

products.title: Paris Corner Minya Cocolush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Minya Cocolush Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet, fruity and floral scent with a creamy gourmand twist. Launched in 2024, this fragrance opens with fresh, juicy notes of coconut water, raspberry and pear that feel light and happy. The heart blooms with jasmine and freesia, giving a gentle floral touch. The dry down turns warm and tasty with macarons, musk and amber, making the scent cozy, smooth and slightly dessert like but not heavy.

products.title: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette is a fresh unisex fragrance from the house of Calvin Klein. Launched in 2017, it carries the modern spirit of youth and freedom with a clean citrus profile. The perfume opens with a burst of bergamot, mandarin orange, and grapefruit blossom giving a bright and zesty start. The heart notes bring out jasmine, rhubarb, freesia, and lily adding a soft floral touch with a hint of green freshness. Finally, the dry down settles into warm and smooth notes of musk, amber, and vetiver, making it a balanced scent that feels both uplifting and comforting.

products.title: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum is a creamy, luscious and sophisticated scent for women that is utterly warm and enigmatic. The fragrance begins with a peppery the spicy touch of ginger, and cardamom that is bold and rich. Bit by bit, the gentle notes of coconut, gardenia, and orange blossom are revealed and they make the fragrance smooth and feminine. At the end, sandalwood, musk, and amber provide an elegant and enduring finish. This fragrance is characterized by sensuality, self-assurance, and suitability for special occasions.

products.title: Lattafa Ramz Gold Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ramz Gold Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and fruity scent that feels both bright and soft. It starts off with an explosion of fruits like a crunchy apple, juicy peach, tangy blackcurrant, sweet pear and zesty orange. The floral heart consists of rose, jasmine and orange blossom which not only imparts a fresh quality but also smooths the scent. The base is a mix of milk and warmth with sandalwood, white musk, vanilla and patchouli.

products.title: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Gold Eau de Parfum is a rich, warm and creamy scent for both men and women. Starting with a golden soft and sweet mix of caramel and saffron, the heart contains suede, leather and tonka bean which smooth out the scent and give it depth. The vanilla, amber and musk in the base provide a long-lasting warm and pleasant trail.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum is a joyful, dreamy, and fresh fragrance for women who love to feel confident, young, and free-spirited. This new perfume is inspired by the beauty of blooming magnolia flowers, mixed with fruity and creamy touches that make you feel happy from the first spray.

Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia is playful yet elegant. The top notes bring juicy dewberry, soft coconut, and a splash of fresh orange. The heart is full of magnolia petals, jasmine sambac, ylang-ylang, and lily of the valley, giving a lovely floral touch. In the base, warm musk, patchouli, and blonde woods make Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia long-lasting and soft.

This fragrance is for women who want to stand out sweetly and freshly, whether at work, on a date, or at a special event. One spray of Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum can lift your mood and add a touch of floral magic to your day.

products.title: Creed Aventus Absolu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Aventus Absolu Eau De Parfum is the boldest, freshest version of the iconic Aventus ever made. It’s a limited-edition fragrance that turns up the volume on the signature Creed DNA making it fruitier, fresher, and even more irresistible. Designed for the man who owns the room with confidence and class, Creed Aventus Absolu blends the juicy brightness of grapefruit and blackcurrant with a refined woody base. The result? A modern, luxurious fragrance that smells powerful, clean, and classy at the same time.

Creed Aventus Absolu is all about making a statement whether you’re heading to a high-profile meeting, a wedding, or just want to feel elite. Every spray feels rich, fresh, and uplifting perfect for Indian men who appreciate sharp, long-lasting luxury.

products.title: Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum is a soft, elegant, and modern floral fragrance made for today’s confident women. Launched in 2010, Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum brings together the timeless beauty of fresh roses, warm spices, creamy sandalwood, and smooth musk. The result is a gentle yet long-lasting perfume that makes you feel fresh, graceful, and feminine all day long.

This beautiful fragrance is perfect for daily wear or for special occasions when you want to feel extra special and noticed. One spray of Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum is enough to leave behind a delicate floral trail that feels comforting and classy at the same time.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Couture Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Couture Noir Eau de Parfum is an affordable, luxurious, and unisex signature perfume from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. It is an interesting take on modern citrusy and crispy fruity notes of lemon and apple with warmer and heavier leather, patchouli, amber, and musk with a bit of nature-based accords of lily of the valley and oakmoss.

products.title: Lattafa Al Qiam Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Al Qiam Eau de Parfum is a beautiful unisex perfume that feels clean, woody, and modern. It opens with a burst of grapefruit and ginger, which gives a bright and spicy freshness. After that, the heart of the perfume is made by ambroxan and sandalwood, giving a slightly warm and soft woody smell. The base consists of musk and vetiver, which produce a warm and earthy dry down that is very close to your skin. It is fresh but deep, ideal for everyday use or special occasions.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Parfum is a soft, elegant and very feminine perfume. It reveals a combination of fresh rose and a delicate fruity touch of peach at the very beginning. The middle notes consist primarily of pure white musky scent, which is layered with the warmth of amber. The base consists of patchouli and sandalwood, which provide a smooth, woody finish.

products.title: Lattafa Velvet Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Velvet Musk Eau de Parfum is a soft and clean unisex perfume that feels calm, smooth and cozy on skin. It starts off with white musk and a light touch of black tea, giving a fresh but warm start. The heart is a mixture of iris, which is powdery and sweet vanilla. The base consists of cedarwood, amber and coumarin, which result in a soft, woody and slightly sweet base that is very close to the skin.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Aariz Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Arabiyat Prestige Aariz is a modern, fresh, and exquisite fragrance designed for everyone. It perfectly captures the feeling of a cool, gentle breeze on a warm day. Aariz is a scent that feels both sophisticated and comforting, blending bright, happy notes with a soft, clean heart.

Aariz smells like confidence and charm in a bottle. It has a beautiful freshness that makes it easy to wear, while its rich base gives it a character that is hard to forget. It’s the perfect choice for those who want a signature scent that is unique, versatile, and consistently receives compliments. One spray of Aariz makes you feel polished, modern, and ready for anything.

products.title: Amouage Outlands Essences de Parfum
products.body_html: Amouage Outlands Essences de Parfum is a deep, bold, and intense unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, this scent feels dark, spicy and smoky right from the first spray. It starts with a strong touch of incense combined with fresh citrus and warm spices that creates a strong first impression. As it dries, Amouage Outlands Essences de Parfum grows more multifaceted and full bodied, the pleasant earth patchouli smell, tender flower and spice aromas fading in. It is heavy and long lasting with the smell of frankincense, oud, amber, vanilla and resin that are warm and mysterious and very luxurious.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau de Parfum is a bold and luxurious unisex fragrance. Introduced in 2017, it literally combines all the notes of the fresh, spicy, and warm fragrance family making the whole composition leather-centric and smooth. The fruity and spicy mix of juniper berries, cardamom, pink pepper, and raspberry marks up the top notes. The middle has the floral and slightly hot scent of iris, ginger, and rose. The bottom or base note is composed of a combination of leather, white musk, and amber, which are rich and sensual thus leaving a long-lasting impression.

products.title: Ajmal Aristocrat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Aristocrat Eau De Parfum was launched in 2017 by Ajmal fragrance house based in UAE as a woody floral musk scent with a citric opening and a musky drydown. Alongside the zesty lime and bergamot notes, the opening is adorned with melon sweetness, the heart speaks of floral lily and jasmine while dancing in a musk wind; and the drydown is like a sunset- soft and satisfying with pleasant woody notes of amber, oud patchouli and cedar.

products.title: Rayhaan Imperia Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Imperia Eau de Parfum is a fresh, woody aromatic men’s perfume for those who like clean yet bold fragrances. It opens with a lively mix of bergamot, apple, mint and elemi, offering a fresh, slightly sweet start. The middle notes of patchouli, jasmine, rose and sandalwood add a soft, woody, floral touch. In the dry down, cedar, oakmoss, amber and musk blend smoothly to create a warm, masculine base that feels classy and long lasting.

products.title: Mancera  Red Tobacco Intense Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Red Tobacco Intense Extrait de Parfum is a very strong, bold and dark fragrance made for people who love heavy scents. This was launched in 2023 as a more powerful and creamier version of the original Red Tobacco. It opens spicy and smoky, then slowly turns warm, sweet and woody. The high oil concentration makes it long lasting and very intense, so even small sprays are enough.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Cranberry Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Cranberry Musk Eau de Parfum is a very gentle, fresh, and somewhat sweet perfume among others made for women and men at the same time. First on your skin is a pleasant mix of cranberry, lotus, and freesia that is light and refreshing. After a while, the fragrance becomes creamy and silky with musk, pear, and jasmine in the core. During the last phase, sandalwood and vanilla contribute a warm and soft feeling. This perfume emits a serene, pure, and contemporary aura thus making it suitable for everyday use.

products.title: Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense Eau de Parfum is a strong and classy men’s perfume who like bold and fresh smell. It opens with a bright citrus touch of bergamot and lemon with soft elemi. The middle notes create a woody and floral landscape with lily of the valley and jasmine, which is creamy and clean at the same time. The base is warm and long lasting with musk, patchouli and amber that stays on the skin.

products.title: French Avenue Vulcan Baie Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Vulcan Baie Eau de Parfum French Avenue is a fresh, fruitful and a bit warm perfume that is produced to suit both men and women. It opens with fat juicy black currant and blackberry with a fresh tint of bergamot and rosemary which feels good and cheerful. The vodka and raspberry are used in the middle with a sweet and smooth finish with a gentle floral touch. The fragrance is long lasting as the base is comfortable and full of musk, sandalwood, and amber.

products.title: Diptyque Doson Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Do Son Eau de Parfum is a luminous and elegant floral fragrance that captures the beauty of white‑flowers in full bloom. It opens with fresh touches of orange blossom and pink pepper that add a sparkling brightness, then evolves into rich tuberose and jasmine in the heart, and settles on warm musks and benzoin. It is created for both women and men who love refined, floral scents that feel both clean and seductive.

products.title: Paris Corner Taskeen Caramel Cascade Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Taskeen Caramel Cascade Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy, gourmand scent made for both men and women. Launched in 2024, it brings a delicious blend of caramel and milk in the opening, followed by soft notes of tonka bean and honey in the middle. The drydown settles into a warm base of vanilla and white musk, giving it a smooth, cozy finish that feels comforting and addictive.

products.title: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Arabians Tonka Eau de Parfum is a warm, rich and sweet oriental scent made for both men and women. It combines bold spices with deep woods and smooth sweetness. The very beginning gives us saffron and bergamot, which form a brilliant start with a bit of spice. The heart is, of course, very powerful with oud and Bulgarian rose. Finally, the dry down is very warm and cozy with tonka bean, sugar cane, amber, white musk and oakmoss.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdijan Grand Soir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Grand Soir Eau de Parfum is a creamy, warm and elegant unisex perfume launched in 2016 by the luxury French perfume house Maison Francis Kurkdjian. It opens with a smooth mix of Spanish labdanum and a light touch of orange, which feels warm and slightly sweet. The heart brings lavender and Siam benzoin, which add a calm, resin like depth. The base is deep and comforting with amber, vanilla, tonka bean, musk and cedar, giving the perfume its signature long lasting warmth.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Dubai Night Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Dubai Night Extrait de Parfum is a rich and warm scent made for men who like deep and classy fragrances. It is a new release from the famous Al Haramain house in 2024. The perfume opens with spicy saffron, fresh bergamot and soft elemi. The heart carries strong agarwood with elegant Bulgarian rose and gentle lily of the valley. The base settles into sweet tonka bean, warm amber, clean white musk and earthy oakmoss.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir Eau De Parfum is a clean, deep and modern scent made for men who like simple but classy perfumes. It opens smooth and fresh, then slowly turns dark, woody and musky. This fragrance feels calm, confident and very elegant without being loud. It is perfect for daily wear as well as special evenings. The musky heart makes it feel warm and personal, almost like a skin scent but stronger.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Lazy Sunday Morning Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Lazy Sunday Morning Eau de Toilette is a soft and clean perfume that smells like fresh sheets, warm sunlight and a slow, cozy morning. It is a soft and unisex aroma made up of lighthearted flowers, a little bit of pear, soft rose and iris in the middle and a velvety warm base of white musk, ambrette and a whisper of patchouli leaf.

products.title: Kayali Utopia Vanilla Coco 21 Eau De Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Kayali Utopia Vanilla Coco 21 Eau De Parfum Intense is an Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. It was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Gabriela Chelariu. Top notes are Coconut Milk, Honeysuckle, Pear Blossom and Italian Lemon; middle notes are Tuberose, Jasmine Sambac, Gardenia and Ambrette; base notes are Bourbon Vanilla, Sandalwood, Musk and Patchouli.

products.title: French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum is a dark, bold and smoky leather men’s perfume made for those who like strong scents. It was launched in 2023 and opens with incense, gaiac wood and saffron, which feels warm and mysterious. The middle brings leather with a soft, sweet touch from violet and sugar cane. The base is deep and smoky with patchouli, sandalwood, woods and black musk that stays long on skin. Overall, French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum feels powerful, mature and very confident.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Nyla Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Nyla Eau de Parfum is an elegant, soft, and floral perfume intended for women who are fond of fresh and sweet fragrances. It starts with a delightful blend of coconut, peach, bergamot, and mandarin which is very uplifting and cheerful. The middle note consists of tiare, white flowers, jasmine, and rose that impart a velvety floral note. The long-lasting background of white musk and patchouli is warm and pure on the skin.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum is a warm, bold, and luxurious unisex fragrance that blends rich spices with smooth oud and sweet undertones. Launched in 2021, Supremacy in Oud quickly became popular for its exotic vibe and modern twist on classic oriental scents.

The first spray of Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum brings a burst of spicy saffron and nutmeg, balanced with calming lavender. The heart reveals deep agarwood (oud) mixed with sweet notes that add a smooth, comforting layer. The dry down is warm and long-lasting with earthy patchouli and soft musk, giving this perfume a rich, lasting finish.

Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who love powerful, spicy, and woody scents that make them stand out wherever they go.

products.title: Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum is an oriental fragrance available for women and men. It was released in 2016 and developed by perfumer Aurélien Guichard. This fragrance begins with the notes of frankincense, raspberry, saffron and pear that are a bombard of smoky and sweet sweetness. Damask rose, musk and orange blossom, agarwood (oud) and leather with patchouli and ambergris are reported to be the damask rose, the base, and the other, respectively. It is courageous, intense and highly opulent to the skin.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense by Gucci is a woman's musky fragrance that is floral and based on wood. It is a new perfume that will be released in 2025. It is initially bright after which it gradually turns creamy and soft to the skin. Gardenia mixed with hedione to a feminine touch is soothing in the heart. The sandalwood base is also a source of warmth and long hours. It is classy, contemporary and somewhat addictive.

products.title: Frederic Malle Portrait Of A Lady Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Frederic Malle Portrait Of A Lady Eau De Parfum is an elegant and bold fragrance created by master perfumer Dominique Ropion in 2010. It’s a timeless perfume that captures grace, mystery, and confidence in every spray. The fragrance opens with rich and spicy top notes of rose, clove, cinnamon, black currant, and red berries. The heart unfolds with Turkish rose, patchouli, incense, sandalwood, and ylang-ylang, blending beautifully into a deep and sensual base of musk, amber, benzoin, cedar, ambergris, vanilla, and incense.

products.title: Ajmal Wisal Layl Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Wisal Layl Eau de Parfum is a rich and elegant unisex fragrance from the house of Ajmal. It is a soft yet deep floral scent with a warm oriental touch. The perfume opens with sweet fruity notes of blackcurrant and apricot mixed with fresh freesia. A beautiful rose with patchouli and gentle osmanthus flowers is felt in the middle of the perfume. The base is warm and very long lasting, with musk, oud and frankincense giving it an Arabic, luxurious feel.

products.title: Paris Corner Choco Cult Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Choco Cult Eau de Parfum is a creamy, sweet, unisex perfume made for people who love dessert like scents. It opens with creamy caramel mixed with fresh orange and bergamot, giving a soft, sweet citrus start. The middle is a full chocolate fantasy with cocoa, coconut, butter, peach and blackcurrant notes that feel smooth, tasty and cozy. The base dries down into warm vanilla, sandalwood and musk, making the scent comforting, creamy and addictive with a soft gourmand trail.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Toilette is a soft, classy women’s perfume. It is known for its clean musky feel with light flowers and warm woods. This fragrance feels elegant but simple, not loud at all. It has a fresh and floral opening, gradually becoming creamy and warm on the skin. It is a perfume that feels very close, smooth and comforting, so that it is suitable for everyday use and special moments as well.

products.title: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Platine Prive Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Guerlain L’Homme Idéal Platine Privé Eau de Toilette is a modern and stylish fragrance for men. It opens with fresh and zesty top notes of grapefruit and bergamot, moves into a soft and elegant heart of green almond and neroli, and finishes with a warm and masculine base of musk and vetiver. This perfume is perfect for confident men who like a clean, refined, and classy scent.

products.title: Dunhill Signature Amalfi Citrus Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: The Dunhill Signature Amalfi Citrus Eau de Parfum is a fresh and clean perfume that is bright and classy on the skin of men. It starts off with a citrusy burst of lemon, bergamot and orange that is very fresh and invigorating. Gradually, it passes into a creamy centre of neroli, green tea and light spices, which are soothing and graceful. Vetiver, musk and soft woods form the base to providea clean woody finish which remains fresh on skin. This perfume is relaxed, luxurious and easy to wear.

products.title: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Black Eau De Parfum is a bold men’s fragrance made for the party spirit. Released in 2017, this scent mixes strong spicy, herbal and sweet notes into a modern aromatic fougere blend. The fragrance opens with absinthe, anise, and fennel for a sharp and spicy start. Lavender in the heart brings balance and freshness. In the base, black vanilla husk and musk add a dark, sensual touch that lasts long on the skin. It is daring, masculine and smooth perfect for evening events and night outs.

products.title: Versace Man Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Man Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette is a men's fragrance that is fresh and clean, light, cool, and classy at the same time. Citrus freshness that is very sharp and refreshing is the first thing that you notice when you spray it. After some time, a little bit of soft spicy and herbal notes get revealed and create a very nice balancing act. In the end, a gentle touch of woody and musky notes is almost imperceptibly close to the skin but still exudes a calm and masculine aura. This fragrance is an excellent choice for everyday use, for the office, and in hot climates.

products.title: Riiffs Bella Rouge Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Bella Rouge Eau de Parfum is a soft yet bold feminine scent from Riiffs Perfumes. It is a pretty oriental floral perfume that opens with fresh, spicy notes of blood orange, pink pepper and lemon zest, giving a bright, lively feel. The heart opens to romantic damask rose, light freesia and relaxing tea leaf, and the smell is graceful and soft. The base settles into white musk, patchouli and amberwood, providing a warm and slightly sweet end that remains near the skin and is comforting.

products.title: Le Labo Another 13 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo Another 13 Eau de Parfum is an unisex perfume that is soft but mysterious, and clean, musky, and faintly woody. It begins with a fresh touch of pear, apple and a sweet tang of citrus, which is airy and smooth. Gradually, the ambrette and the jasmine enter, with a warm musky touch. During the dry down, Iso E Super and Cetalox form a skin-like woody smell that is close to the skin but is long-lasting. It is contemporary, sparse, and subdued hard.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Lutfah The Seventh Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Lutfah The Seventh Heaven Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, this fragrance feels rich, warm and slightly spicy with a deep Arabic touch. It opens with a fresh spicy mix of pink pepper, bright Sicilian bergamot and sweet davana that feels uplifting and classy. The heart is warm and resinous with white amber, agarwood and herbal rosemary, giving a calm but powerful feel. The base is deep and long lasting with leather, earthy Haitian vetiver, and soft musk that stays on skin for hours and feels luxurious.

products.title: Ajmal Aurum Summer Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Aurum Summer Eau De Parfum is a feminine scent that was launched in 2020 by the Ajmal fragrance house based in the UAE as a vibrant and graceful fruity floral scent with a musk base that gives a creamy and soft drydown. It opens like a zesty fruit bowl on a warm summer day with its apple, pear, bergamot, red fruits, and mandarin orange; develops to the grace of a bouquet of rose, orange blossom, peony, osmanthus, and jasmine; and a soft drydown of a musky base with oakmoss, cedar, vanilla and sandalwood notes.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Lah di Da For Her Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Lah di Da For Her Eau de Parfum is a sweet, playful and very feminine fragrance made for women who enjoy soft gourmand scents. It opens with juicy fruits and sweetness that feels bright and happy from the first spray. The heart is floral and creamy, giving it a smooth and elegant touch without feeling heavy. As it settles, Arabiyat Prestige Lah di Da For Her Eau de Parfum turns warm and comforting base with vanilla and soft musk.

products.title: Lattafa Sherif Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Sherif Eau de Parfum is a fresh and woody men's perfume, which is clean, smooth, and classy. It begins with the ripe apple and sunny bergamot touch that is vigorous and crisp. Gradually, the heart is made more of cedarwood and soft violet, so that it feels rather peaceful and slightly dusty. On its foundation, oakmoss, musk, and amber provide a very cosy and lasting effect. It is stinking of modernity, confident, and easy to wear.

products.title: Riiffs Rose de Soleil Eclat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Rose de Soleil Éclat Eau de Parfum is a bright and fruity floral fragrance for women that feels sweet, fresh, and warm. The opening is juicy and lively with mango, Sicilian lemon, wild berries, and a soft touch of pink pepper. Slowly, the heart turns creamy and slightly spicy with ginger and jasmine, blended with smooth tonka bean and vanilla. In the dry down, white musk, amber, and vetiver give a clean, soft, and long-lasting finish. It feels sunny, feminine, and perfect for everyday wear.

products.title: Guerlain Shalimar Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Shalimar Eau De Parfum is one of those perfumes that are warm, daring, and classic all at once, and the oriental richness is definitely the main reason for its popularity among perfume lovers. It starts with citrus notes, illuminating bergamot and lemon, then goes into a deep floral-earthy heart consisting of iris, jasmine, rose, vetiver, and patchouli, finally ending in a soft base of vanilla, incense, leather, sandalwood, and musk. It is perceived as classic, smooth, slightly smoky, and elegant with a very effortless touch.

products.title: French Avenue Irida Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Irida Extrait de Parfum is a unisex perfume, which is warm, sweet, and spicy in scent. French Avenue released this perfume in 2024, and it is created to be liked by those who appreciate both strong and smooth odours. It begins with a fat cherry that is intertwined with a light ginger touch, followed by the soft jasmine. The foundation is comfortable and warm, which makes it ideal to wear it daily and for evening use.

products.title: Calvin Klein Ck One Shock Eau De Toilette
products.body_html:
Calvin klein Ck One Shock Eau De Toilette is a masculine fragrance which was launched in 2011 this scent opens with a sharp burst of lavender, juicy clementine and refreshing cucumber the middle reveals a spicy combination of cardamom, pepper, basil and osmanthus creating an energetic kick. Finally this fragrance dries down into an addictive base of tobacco, amber, patchouli, woodsy notes and musk
This composition offers a modern twist with its oriental spicy accords making it an ideal choice for men who enjoy a confident and powerful scent.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Eau de Toilette is a powerful and timeless scent for men that projects an image of boldness, cleanliness, and strength. It starts with a crisp and fresh odor that is very cheerful and somewhat spicy, then gradually changes to warmth and depth. The combination of herbs, flowers, and animalic notes gives it a very masculine and assured character. This fragrance is a classic, heavy, and best suited for the men who appreciate strong perfumes.

products.title: Rasasi Daarej Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Daarej Pour Femme Eau de Parfum is a sweet, soft and elegant women's fragrance. It opens with juicy fruity notes of peach, orange and bergamot mixed with fresh green accords that feel bright and happy. The heart comes with creamy white florals like jasmine, tuberose and orchid blended with heliotrope and lily-of-the-valley, giving a powdery, feminine touch. The dry down is warm and cozy with caramel, musk, sandalwood, vetiver, amber and patchouli creating a sweet yet classy scent trail that feels smooth and comforting.

products.title: Burberry London Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry London Eau de Parfum is a classic floral scent that exudes elegance and timeless appeal. Launched in 2006, this fragrance opens with sweet honeysuckle, fresh tangerine, and soft rose (top notes), followed by jasmine, tiare flower, peony, and clementine (middle notes) and finishes with warm musk, sandalwood, and patchouli (base notes). A perfect combination of freshness, florals, and warmth makes it one of the most loved Burberry perfumes for women.

products.title: Billie Eilish No. 1
products.body_html: Billie Eilish No. 1 Eau de Parfum is the first fragrance by Billie Eilish. It is warm, sweet and slightly spicy, wrapped around soft vanilla and cacao. The perfume opens with sugar, red berries and mandarin orange that feel bright and sweet. The heart brings in a smooth combination of vanilla, cacao, rose, and a hint of spice. The base is cosy with amber, tonka bean, musk, and woody notes that stay close to the skin. It feels sensual, sweet, and comforting, just like Billie wanted it to be.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum is a rich and modern unisex perfume with a strong oriental touch. It starts with a fruity and spicy mixture of mango, saffron, citrus and soft florals that are bright but warm at the same time. The middle note is amber, rose, iris and black tea that are smooth and slightly smoky. The base is deep, woody and very long lasting with oud, tonka bean, patchouli, musk and cedar, which gives it a bold and classy finish that feels lavish but is still easy to wear.

products.title: French Avenue Spicy Amber Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Spicy Amber Eau de Parfum is a warm, bold and cozy fragrance made for both men and women. It starts with a creamy blend of incense and coffee, which has a hint of rose that provides a nice beginning. The cedar and cashmere wood make the heart stiff and chilly, which gives the scent a rich texture. As it dries down, Spicy Amber becomes creamy and slightly sweet with vanilla, mixed with earthy vetiver and clean musk.

products.title: Versace Eau Fraiche Extreme Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eau Fraiche Extreme Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a fresh fragrance scent for men that is clean, to some extent spicy and woody. The introduction is characterised by lemony and orange blossom that is pleasingly citrusy and vibrant, with a slight spicy touch of pink pepper. It is given a gentle aromatic touch after some time by lavender, clary sage, and geranium. During the dry up, the ambroxan, musk and cedar form a smooth woody foundation that is retained for hours on the skin. It is classy, clean and certain, excellent for individuals who like a sophisticated smell on a daily basis.

products.title: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette is a lovely, elegant, and somewhat enigmatic fragrance for women that is reminiscent of creamy flowers. It begins with a spicy mix of pepper, cardamom, and ginger, which is fresh yet warm at the same time. It gradually transitions to a delicate floral heart where gardenia and orange blossom are rich and ladies-like. The combination of sandalwood, musk, and amber at the base provides a warm and clean finish, which is very close to the skin and feels very classy.

products.title: Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau De Parfum special fragrance is perfect for both men and women who love a warm, woody scent with a touch of elegance. Dirham Oud is a beautiful combination of fresh notes and deep, earthy tones, creating a perfume that feels both modern and classic.

This fragrance is a journey for your senses. It starts with a bright and zesty burst of fruits, then moves to a soft floral heart, and finally settles into a powerful, lasting base of woods and oud. It's a scent that makes you feel confident and sophisticated, perfect for any occasion where you want to make a statement.

products.title: Riiffs Wonder Of You Pour Femme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Wonder Of You Pour Femme Eau De Parfum is a soft, sweet and warm fragrance made for women who love a little fruity and creamy touch. It opens with juicy pink grapefruit, red apple and peach that feel fresh and playful. Slowly, rose petals, magnolia, and orange blossom come in and give a pretty floral heart. In the dry down, musk, vanilla and amber make it smooth, cosy and long-lasting. It feels feminine, gentle and very easy to wear.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance. Launched in 2023, it carries a warm oriental woody scent profile that blends fruity herbal freshness with deep woody richness. The opening starts with davana, bergamot and pink pepper, giving a slightly sweet spicy feel. The heart unfolds into creamy agarwood, oud, amber and rosemary that create a warm aromatic body. The base settles into leather, vetiver and musk, which adds depth, softness and a long lasting trail. The blend feels smooth, bold and balanced with a classy Middle Eastern touch.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Delina Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Delina is an irresistible, sophisticated, soft floral scent that belongs to the group of women who are fond of fresh and romantic perfumes. The opening is a vibrant, rather sweet and quite pleasant, juicy combination of litchi and rhubarb. With a beautiful Turkish rose accompanied by peony and soft musk, the heart is slowly revealing itself. The base is warm and smooth, composed of woods and incense, thus making the scent elegant and of good duration.

products.title: Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum, a fresh and powerful fragrance for men, is a perfect choice for those who want to stay bright, clean, and lively. The fragrance starts with a strong and very fresh burst of citrus notes that are really energizing. Gradually, it goes to a spicy and slightly sweet heart that provides depth and balance. The base is woody and musky, resulting in a smooth and long-lasting finish. This scent is modern, confident, and bold, absolutely perfect for men who prefer fresh but strong perfumes.

products.title: Riiffs Mystere Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Mystere Eau de Parfum is a soft, elegant floral perfume for women who like sweet and classy scents. It opens fresh and fruity, then turns into creamy white flowers and finally dries down into warm vanilla and musk. The combination feels feminine, gentle and attractive.

products.title: Lattafa Ra'ed Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ra’ed Silver Eau de Parfum is a warm and spicy unisex scent with a bright citrus opening and a deep, sweet, woody base. It starts with fresh hints of citruses, spices and mandarin orange, then moves into a rich heart of cinnamon, saffron, amber and cloves. The base settles into soft vanilla, musk, leather, oud and a touch of ambergris.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Eau de Toilette is a male perfume that was introduced in 1996. It is produced using fresh citrus tones, sea tones and gentle woody tones that are very clean and natural. The introductory is bright, fresh and very gradually becomes liquid and smooth. During the dry down, it is hot and dry. This perfume is light, clean and comfortable to use; it suits everyday and hot seasons.

products.title: Davidoff Essentials Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Davidoff Essentials Blue Eau de Toilette is the everyday perfume that offers a clean and fresh smell to men. The perfume starts with citrus, mint and lavender, which is refreshing and invigorating. The perfume is formed together with jasmine and basil which produce a light spicy scent. The final stage is due to the amber, musk and cedarwood that form a smooth woody scent. The perfume comes out as a simple male fragrance that is appropriate for everyday usage.

products.title: Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau De Toilette is a fresh fragrance for men. Launched in 2007, it mixes fruity, aromatic, and woody notes into a smooth and lively scent. The perfume opens with crisp green apple and bitter orange, giving a fresh and bright start. Its heart is warm with tea and subtle spices, while the base brings a masculine touch of musk, tonka bean, vetiver, cedar, oakmoss, and amber. Chrome Legend is a perfect mix of freshness and depth for everyday wear.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Sun Song Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Sun Song Eau de Parfum is a bright and fresh citrus perfume for women and men. It was released in 2019 and designed by Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. The perfume begins with a clear and juicy citron, which is clear and active. Orange blossom then adds the sweetness of a soft, floral taste. The musk in the bottom provides it with a smooth and warm feel that remains close to the skin. It reeks of summer sunshine, light, happy and easy to wear. Its weight is not excessive, it is not too sweet, and it is only fresh and glowing.

products.title: Versace Dylan Blue Woman Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Dylan Blue Woman Eau de Parfum is a new and elegant women’s fragrance that gives off a clean, fruity, and slightly floral vibe. It starts with a vivid combination of apple and black currant that feels juicy and fresh. Gradually, the perfume develops its floral note with rose and jasmine that feel classy and silky. The base notes consist of musk and soft woods, which are clean and comforting. This perfume seems to be chic, contemporary, and suitable for daily use.

products.title: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau De Toilette is a contemporary men's fragrance that is fresh, clean, and modern with a smooth and energetic feel. The top notes are a bergamot and pink pepper freshness that is cool and purifying. The middle notes consist of soothing and somewhat powdery lavender, iris, and sage. In the base, musk and caramel impart gentle sweetness along with the richness of wood. The fragrance is sophisticated, fresh, and ideal for everyday use.

products.title: Dumont Nitro Black Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro Black Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern men’s fragrance that mixes freshness with deep woody warmth. It opens with a burst of fruity notes, pineapple, bergamot, black currant and apple that give a clean and bright start. The nature of the scent turns richer with pepper, birch, patchouli, jasmine, lavender and rose, adding spice and class. In the end, musk, amber and vanilla create a smooth and comforting base that lasts long.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toillete for Woman
products.body_html: Light Blue Eau De Toilette Dolce Gabbana is a fresh and iconic floral fruity perfume. It was released in 2001 and designed by perfumer Olivier Cresp. The smell starts with sparkling Sicilian lemon and apple, which provides a fresh and crisp touch with a light woody scent of cedar and bellflower. Then it passes to the soft notes of jasmine, white rose, and bamboo to make it light and feminine. Musk, amber and cedar form the foundation of the clean and smooth finish that is fresh throughout the day.

products.title: Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar Eau De Parfum is a bold and fresh men’s fragrance from the luxury house of Bvlgari. Launched in 2016, this perfume is inspired by the power of the Tiger’s Eye stone, symbolising strength and confidence. The fragrance opens with the brightness of grapefruit, combining into spicy and musky tones of ginger and ambrette, and settles into a smooth base of ambroxan, musk, vetiver, and patchouli. A perfect scent for men who love a fresh, strong, and modern aroma.

products.title: Bvlgari  Rose Goldea Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Rose Goldea Eau De Parfum produces a feminine and soft smell that is filled with a romantic and elegant touch. The smell has a fresh and rosy start with a delicate fruity scent that creates a clean and light impression. The fragrance evolves into a floral heart that harbours the smell of rose and soft flowers. The lower level of the perfume is a blend of warm fragrances and creamy musk, sandalwood and vanilla, which are still close to the skin. The perfume gives a very elegant, feminine smell that can be used on a daily basis.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Silver Eau de Parfum is a clean, fresh and sharp fragrance for men & women that feels bright and confident. It opens with cold and crisp notes like juniper berries, nutmeg, bergamot and a small touch of pineapple that makes the start feel energetic. The heart brings coriander for a dry spicy tone, while the base settles into soft musk, woody notes, cedar, amber and a hint of vanilla.

products.title: Franck Olivier Blue Touch Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Blue Touch Eau De Toilette is a fresh scent. It feels like you’re standing right by the ocean. But there's a nice woody accent mixed in too. It came out in 2011. It has a bright, zesty opening. You get a big rush of lemon, bergamot, green leaves, tangerine, and a small hint of pink pepper. It feels like a sunny morning. The middle section is cool and deep. This gives it a manly feel. That comes from melon, patchouli, vetiver, wood smells, sage, and galbanum. In the end, it gets warm. You get a lingering fresh scent from musk, oakmoss, and amber. This fragrance is for men who like clean, fresh, and maybe slightly spicy smells.

products.title: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum is a modern floral women’s perfume for those who like soft but noticeable fragrance. Launched in 2024, it brings a fresh and clean floral style built with bright bergamot in the opening, a heart of jasmine and neroli, and a soft musky base with ambrette.

products.title: Dumont Paris Nitro Platinum Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nitro Paris Platinum Eau de Parfum is a contemporary woody fragrance perfume targeting men who prefer serious and sweet perfumes. It begins with a fresh and juicy combination of spices and fruits that is vibrant and vigorous. Gradually, it becomes warm and smooth vanilla, sugar, and soft woods. The foundation is deep, creamy, and long-lasting with a great and assertive feel. The perfume seems trendy, very expensive and can be worn daily or on nights.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Royal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Royal Eau de Parfum is a unisex scent that brings together the luxuriousness of oud and warm, spicy fragrances. Launched in 2023, it starts with a note of glamorous saffron and fresh lavender, then a heart of strong oud and nutmeg, all resting on an attractive base of patchouli and musk.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir Parfum
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir Parfum is a deep, elegant men’s fragrance from the designer house of Narciso Rodriguez. Released in 2022, it is a smooth woody musk scent with a modern dark twist. The scent opens fresh and spicy with cardamom, citrus and cypress, then moves into a soft heart of iris, musk and suede. The base is creamy and warm with sandalwood, leather, vetiver and tonka bean, giving it a clean yet sensual masculine feel that works all year.

products.title: Marc-Antoine Barrois Ganyemede Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Marc-Antoine Barrois Ganymede Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance that combines woody and spicy notes into a bold and modern scent. The perfume was introduced in 2019, and its top notes feature the lively and refreshing saffron and Italian mandarin, the soft heart of Chinese osmanthus, violet leaf and immortelle follows and at the same time the base is composed of the warm sensual notes of suede and human musk, cedar, patchouli and akigalawood, making it a versatile perfume that suits both day and night wearing.

products.title: Armaf Yum Yum Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Yum Yum Eau de Parfum is a sweet fruity fragrance designed for ladies who adore subtle, playful scents. The top notes are juicy berries, cherry, and orange, which are fresh and fun. Gradually, rose, white flowers, and vanilla reveal their creamy and smooth characters. The bottom line is made up of powdery notes, musk, and amber, which combine to give a gentle warm finish. This perfume is to be considered feminine, comforting and friendly, and so it is ideal for everyday wear.

products.title: Armaf Legesi Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Armaf Legesi Eau de Parfum is the signature scent for the modern man who is confident, sharp, and successful. This fresh and elegant fragrance is designed to make you feel clean and put-together from morning meetings to evening outings. It captures a timeless, classic
charm with a modern twist, making it the perfect everyday companion.Legesi smells incredibly sophisticated and clean. It’s a scent that draws compliments without being loud, creating an aura of professionalism and class. A spray of Armaf Legesi is like putting on a freshly ironed white shirt and a perfectly tailored blazer, it completes your look and prepares you to conquer the day with style.

products.title: Rasasi Royal Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Royal Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh yet classy men’s perfume for those who like a clean but strong smell. It opens with watery sea notes mixed with citrus and green touch, then slowly turns floral and soft in the middle. The drydown is warm, woody and musky, which gives a creamy, long lasting feel.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Althair Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Althair is a warmly sweet and creamy male scent, and it is characterised by a rich vanilla touch. It opens up with spicy cinnamon and cardamom blended with delicate orange blossom and fresh bergamot. Gradually, the fragrance develops into a smooth and sweet combination of bourbon vanilla and a slight resin feel. The foundation reveals a warm and woody depth with praline, tonka, and soft woods. This fragrance is classy, contemporary, and very soothing, which is just right for a confident man.

products.title: Lattafa Raghba Wood Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Raghba Wood Intense Eau de Parfum is a strong oriental-woody scent made for men who enjoy deep, sweet, smoky perfumes. It starts with caramel, licorice, guaiac wood, and cedar. Then it develops in the direction of warm and sweet heart notes of oud, sugar, sandalwood and cashmere wood. The base is creamy and dense with incense, vanilla, amber, oakmoss and musk.

products.title: Kayali Sweet Diamond Pink Pepper Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: The Kayali Sweet Diamond Pink Pepper is a strong, spicy, and sweet fragrance that is bold but soft on the skin at the same time. It has a bright blend of pink pepper, saffron, and bergamot, with a spicy-sweet start, on top. After that, it goes to a magnificent rose and vanilla orchid heart, coming very floral, creamy, and a bit sweet. The bottom notes of amber, sandalwood, patchouli, and musk impart warmth, smoothness, and longevity to the fragrance. It is a perfume that exudes confidence, playfulness, and the ideal choice for a person who enjoys both sweet and spicy scents simultaneously.

products.title: Ex Nihilio Blue Talisman Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ex Nihilio Blue Talisman Eau de Parfum is a clean, bright, smooth, fresh and modern fragrance. It has a juicy pear and fresh citrus that is light and happy to touch on the skin. Ginger is followed by a soft spicy, then a soft floral heart of orange blossom and woody. The bottom is warm and musky and has smooth woods that are long-lived. This perfume is comfortable, cool and sophisticated, to be used in everyday life or during some special occasions.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Mad Madame Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Mad Madame Eau de Parfum is a Chypre perfume that targets women. Mad Madame was launched in 2012. The smell starts off with the fragrance of rose, black currant, amber and freesia. Patchouli, moss, tuberose, peony and jasmine are characteristic of the heart. It has a deep and warm base that is composed of castoreum, white musk, tolu balsam and vanilla absolute. It is a strong perfume targeted at confident women who prefer strong and persistent perfumes.

products.title: Franck Olivier Oud Touch Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Oud Touch Eau De Parfum is very deep and rich. It feels warm, kinda Middle Eastern. It is fancy and bold. They made Oud Touch in 2014. It starts sweet. You smell caramel, raspberry, and orange. This is a smooth, little fruity start. Next, you smell flowers and earth. That is rose, jasmine, and patchouli. This mixes well with the last smells. Those are amber, vanilla, and musk. Franck Olivier Oud Touch is for guys who want a smell that is strong and stays a long time. Oud Touch is nice but easy to wear. It is best for nighttime or big events. The sweet and warm wood smell is perfect. It makes people remember you.

products.title: Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Silver Mountain Water EDP is a fresh and clean fragrance for men and women. It opens with bright and sparkling top notes of bergamot and mandarin orange. The middle notes gives a refreshing green tea and black currant feel, soft and calming. The base adds depth with musk, sandalwood, petitgrain, and galbanum giving it a smooth and lasting scent. It is loved for being light, elegant, and easy to wear daily while still feeling special and luxurious.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Nuit de Feu Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Nuit de Feu Eau De Parfum is a deep and smoky unisex scent that feels warm, dark and very rich. The scent is characterized by very strong incense, leather, oud, olibanum, and musk notes, which altogether make up a bold fragrance that is sure to be remembered on the skin.

products.title: Le Labo Noir 29 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo The Noir 29 Eau de Parfum is a heavy, woody and slightly smoky perfume for both men and women. It is peaceful yet also brash, simultaneously. It is scented after black tea; therefore, it has that dry, warm and slightly sweet feel. It is first open, and then gradually dark, smooth, and reassuring. Fits well with individuals who are fond of beautiful and noble perfumes.

products.title: Kayali Yum Bougee Marshmallow 81 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Yum Boujee Marshmallow Eau de Parfum is a women's fragrance, a floral, fruity gourmand perfume. It was initiated in 2024 and designed by Gabriela Chelariu. It is a sweet, creamy and playful perfume that is targeted at people who are fond of sweet and tender aromatic fragrances. It is youthful, entertaining and somewhat luxurious.

products.title: Dunhill Mongolian Cashmere Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Mongolian Cashmere Eau de Parfum is a gentle and elegant perfume to men, which is warm and soft on the skin. It commences with a light spicy touch of pink pepper blended with fresh mandarin orange that is clean and fresh. Gradually, it shifts into a drying floral core of orris, geranium and rose that is relaxing and refined. The foundation of suede, amber and musk remains warm and comfortable for many hours, as soft cashmere.

products.title: Riiffs Angelique Extrait de Vanilla Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Angelique Extrait de Vanilla Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and smooth unisex scent from Riiffs. Launched in 2021, it is a creamy vanilla-forward fragrance that blends fruity, floral, spicy and woody tones in a very balanced way. The opening starts with soft vanilla orchid, juicy plum and jasmine. The middle feels sweet and cozy with tonka bean, cinnamon, suede, sugar, bark and rose. The base dries down into a warm blend of amber, patchouli, maple and musk, offering a creamy, slightly dark finish that stays close and pleasant on skin.

products.title: Mancera  Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum is a creamy, sweet and fruity unisex perfume. This fragrance opens with a blast of juicy fruits that feel bright, fresh and mouth watering. It has a sweet vibe but still feels classy and smooth. As the perfume settles, soft floral notes start to appear and balance the sweetness very well. The dry down is creamy, warm and musky, which stays on the skin for many hours. Mancera Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum is bold, strong and very long lasting, perfect for people who love fruity and sweet perfumes with power.

products.title: Maison Margiela Dancing on the Moon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Dancing on the Moon Eau de Parfum is a soft, dreamy and light fragrance made for both men and women. The fragrance is a combination of aldehydes with frangipani, jasmine sambac, and iris floral notes, giving the impression of a fresh night breeze. The base of the scent is composed of cashmeran, ambergris, and musk, which are warm notes that stay close to the skin.

products.title: French Avenue Luscious Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Luscious Eau de Parfum is a sweet, warm and tasty smelling fragrance made specially for women who love wealthy gourmand scents. It opens with a creamy, nutty feel mixed with fresh spice, which feels soft but very catchy. As it settles, the perfume becomes cozier and sweeter with edible notes that feel comforting and addictive. The base is warm, smooth and slightly musky, making the scent long lasting and pleasing on the skin. French Avenue Luscious Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who enjoy sweet but balanced perfumes that are not too sharp or loud.

products.title: Franck Olivier Black Touch Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Black Touch Eau De Toilette is a classy, deep masculine scent that blends the comforting nature of wood with a bright touch of spice. The fragrance tends to smooth out and brings a balance as you reach the heart of this scent. The base represents the real depth of the fragrance and is what makes Black Touch last on the skin. It settles beautifully into warm, rich notes of vetiver, Virginia cedar, patchouli, musk, and vanilla, and these notes again bring warmth that welcomes you. Black Touch is for the man who wants to show a strong direct confidence. It has a great balance of both classic and modern sensibility, and is a great evening scent, special occasion scent, or any time you want to send out a strong statement that lasts.

products.title: Creed Royal Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Royal Oud EDP is made for men and women. This perfume is a sophisticated perfume with a spicy and citrusy start moving into warm and woody middle notes and finishing with an elegant base. It opens with top notes of pink pepper, lemon and Sicilian bergamot which give a fresh and amazing impression. The middle notes of cedar, angelica and galbanum add a woody and green touch while the base of sandalwood, agarwood and musk leaves a smooth and long-lasting scent on skin and clothes.
